' ' Script to create new relationships between a single selected element on a diagram and all other elements on the same diagram. ' ' option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript
sub onDiagramScript()
dim currentDiagram as EA.Diagram dim selectedObjectList as EA.Collection dim selectedObject as EA.DiagramObject dim connType ' as String dim connStereotype ' as String
set currentDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram()
if not currentDiagram is nothing then
Repository.SaveDiagram currentDiagram.DiagramID
set selectedObjectList = currentDiagram.SelectedObjects
if selectedObjectList.Count = 1 then
connType = InputBox("Enter mapped connector type:", , "Dependency")
if not IsEmpty( connType) then
connStereotype = InputBox("Enter mapped connector stereotype:", , "Impacts")
if not IsEmpty( connStereotype) then
set selectedObject = selectedObjectList.GetAt(0)
mapDiagramElements currentDiagram, selectedObject, connType, connStereotype
end if
end if
else Session.Prompt "Must select at least one (and only one) element on this diagram.", promptOK end if else Session.Prompt "This script requires a diagram to be visible", promptOK end if
end sub
sub mapDiagramElements( diagram, selectedDiagramObject, connType, connStereotype)
dim selectedElementID ' as Integer dim selectedElement as EA.Element dim relatedDiagramObject as EA.DiagramObject dim relatedElementID ' as Integer dim relatedElement as EA.Element
diagram.Update
Session.Output vbCRLF & "Map Diagram Elements"
selectedElementID = selectedDiagramObject.ElementID
set selectedElement = Repository.GetElementByID( selectedElementID)
for each relatedDiagramObject in diagram.DiagramObjects
if relatedDiagramObject.ElementID <> selectedDiagramObject.ElementID then
relatedElementID = relatedDiagramObject.ElementID
set relatedElement = Repository.GetElementByID(relatedElementID)
addConnector selectedElement, connType, connStereotype, relatedElement
end if
next
Repository.ReloadDiagram( diagram.DiagramID)
Session.Output "Finished!"
end sub
function addConnector( fromElement, connType, connStereotype, toElement)
dim newConnector as EA.Connector
Session.Output "- Creating new " & connStereotype & " " & connType & " relationship from " & fromElement.Name & " to " & toElement.Name & "..."
set newConnector = fromElement.Connectors.AddNew("", connType)
newConnector.Stereotype = connStereotype newConnector.SupplierID = toElement.ElementID
newConnector.Update
fromElement.Connectors.Refresh
set addConnector = newConnector
end function
onDiagramScript

Column.name: Notes
Column.value: <Script Name="Cloning -> Clone Element" Type="Internal" Language="VBScript"/>

Column.name: Script
Column.value:
' ' Diagram script to a new version of the selected elements on a diagram. This will create a copy of an element ' including its built-in properties, tagged values, relationships, child elements, and child diagrams. It will ' also create an <<clone>> generalization to the original version to represent its previous version. '
option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC TM Forum Diagram Script Utilities.Clone Routines
dim lockError ' as Boolean
sub Start()
dim currDiagram as EA.Diagram
set currDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram
if currDiagram is nothing then Session.Prompt "This script requires a diagram to be visible", promptOK else if currDiagram.IsLocked then Session.Prompt "Cannot clone elements on locked diagram", promptOK else CopyDiagramElements currDiagram end if end if
end sub
sub CopyDiagramElements( currDiagram)
dim currDiagramObject as EA.DiagramObject dim diagramPackageID
diagramPackageID = currDiagram.PackageID
for each currDiagramObject in currDiagram.SelectedObjects CreateDiagramObjectCopy currDiagram, currDiagramObject next
currDiagram.Update()
Repository.ReloadDiagram( currDiagram.DiagramID)
end sub
sub CreateDiagramObjectCopy( currDiagram, currDiagramObject)
dim currElementID dim currElement as EA.Element dim diagramPackageID dim diagramPackage as EA.Package dim newElement as EA.Element
lockError = false
currElementID = currDiagramObject.ElementID
set currElement = Repository.GetElementByID( currElementID)
diagramPackageID = currDiagram.PackageID
set diagramPackage = Repository.GetPackageByID( diagramPackageID)
set newElement = diagramPackage.Elements.AddNew( currElement.Name, currElement.Type)
Repository.EnsureOutputVisible "Script"
Session.Output String( 40, "-") Session.Output "Creating clone of '" & currElement.Name & "'..."
CloneElement currElement, newElement
SwapDiagramObject currDiagram, currDiagramObject, currElement, newElement
if lockError then Session.Prompt "One or more relationhips could not be cloned due to locking restrictions." & vbCRLF & vbCRLF & "Examine the Script tab of the System Output window for details.", promptOK end if
Session.Output "Finished!"
end sub
sub CloneElement( currElement, newElement)
dim extendConn as EA.Connector dim clonedGUIDTag as EA.TaggedValue
'CloneElementParent currElement
CopyElementProperties currElement, newElement
Repository.EnsureOutputVisible "Script"
'CopyElementAttributes 'CopyElementConstraints 'CopyElementCustomProperties 'CopyElementEfforts 'CopyElementFiles 'CopyElementIssues 'CopyElementMethods 'CopyElementMetrics 'CopyElementPartitions 'CopyElementRequirements 'CopyElementResources 'CopyElementRisks 'CopyElementScenarios 'CopyElementStateTransitions 'CopyElementTemplateParameters 'CopyElementTests
CopyElementTaggedValues currElement, newElement
CopyElementConnectors currElement, newElement
CopyElementDiagrams currElement, newElement
'CloneElementEmbeddedElements currElement, newElement 'CloneElementChildren currElement, newElement 'CloneStateMachines currElement, newElement
set extendConn = newElement.Connectors.AddNew( "", CLONE_TYPE)
extendConn.SupplierID = currElement.ElementID extendConn.Direction = "Source -> Destination" extendConn.Stereotype = CLONE_STEREOTYPE
extendConn.Update
newElement.Connectors.Refresh
set clonedGUIDTag = newElement.TaggedValues.GetByName( CLONED_GUID)
if clonedGUIDTag is nothing then set clonedGUIDTag = newElement.TaggedValues.AddNew( CLONED_GUID, "") end if
clonedGUIDTag.Value = currElement.ElementGUID
clonedGUIDTag.Update
newElement.TaggedValues.Refresh
end sub
sub CloneElementChildren( currElement, newElement)
dim currChildElement as EA.Element dim newChildElement as EA.Element
if currElement.Elements.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 2, ".") & "Child Elements"
for each currChildElement in currElement.Elements
set newChildElement = newElement.Elements.AddNew( currElement.Name, currElement.Type)
CloneElement currChildElement, newChildElement
next
end if
end sub
sub CopyElementProperties( currElement, newElement)
newElement.Abstract = currElement.Abstract newElement.ActionFlags = currElement.ActionFlags newElement.Alias = currElement.Alias newElement.ClassifierID = currElement.ClassifierID newElement.Complexity = currElement.Complexity newElement.Difficulty = currElement.Difficulty newElement.EventFlags = currElement.EventFlags newElement.ExtensionPoints = currElement.ExtensionPoints newElement.Genfile = currElement.Genfile newElement.Genlinks = currElement.Genlinks newElement.Gentype = currElement.Gentype newElement.Header1 = currElement.Header1 newElement.Header2 = currElement.Header2 newElement.IsActive = currElement.IsActive newElement.IsLeaf = currElement.IsLeaf newElement.IsNew = currElement.IsNew newElement.IsRoot = currElement.IsRoot newElement.IsSpec = currElement.IsSpec newElement.Multiplicity = currElement.Multiplicity newElement.Notes = currElement.Notes newElement.Persistence = currElement.Persistence newElement.Phase = currElement.Phase newElement.Priority = currElement.Priority newElement.PropertyType = currElement.PropertyType newElement.RunState = currElement.RunState newElement.Status = currElement.Status newElement.StereotypeEx = currElement.StereotypeEx newElement.StyleEx = currElement.StyleEx newElement.Subtype = currElement.Subtype newElement.Tablespace = currElement.Tablespace newElement.Tag = currElement.Tag newElement.Visibility = currElement.Visibility
newElement.Name = InputBox( "Enter new element name", "New Element Name", currElement.Name) newElement.Version = InputBox( "Enter new element version", "New Element Version", currElement.Version)
newElement.Update
newElement.TaggedValues.Refresh
end sub
sub CopyElementTaggedValues( currElement, newElement)
dim currTaggedValue as EA.TaggedValue dim newTaggedValue as EA.TaggedValue
if currElement.TaggedValues.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 2, ".") & "Tagged Values"
for each currTaggedValue in currElement.TaggedValues
set newTaggedValue = newElement.TaggedValues.GetByName( currTaggedValue.Name)
if newTaggedValue is nothing then set newTaggedValue = newElement.TaggedValues.AddNew( currTaggedValue.Name,"") end if
newTaggedValue.Value = currTaggedValue.Value newTaggedValue.Notes = currTaggedValue.Notes
newTaggedValue.Update
next
end if
newElement.TaggedValues.Refresh
end sub
sub CopyElementConnectors( currElement, newElement)
dim currConnector as EA.Connector dim newConnector as EA.Connector dim clientEndLocked ' as Boolean dim clientElement as EA.Element dim lockMsg ' as String
if currElement.Connectors.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 2, ".") & "Connectors"
for each currConnector in currElement.Connectors
if not( currConnector.Type = CLONE_TYPE and currConnector.Stereotype = CLONE_STEREOTYPE) then
Session.Output String( 4, ".") & "Cloning Connector " & currConnector.ConnectorGUID & " (" & currConnector.ConnectorID & ") " & currConnector.Type & " <<" & currConnector.Stereotype & ">> "
'set newConnector = newElement.Connectors.AddNew( currConnector.Name, currConnector.Type) set newConnector = createNewConnector( currConnector, currElement, newElement)
'if currConnector.ClientID = currElement.ElementID then ' newConnector.ClientID = newElement.ElementID ' newConnector.SupplierID = currConnector.SupplierID ' clientEndLocked = false 'else
'if currElement.Locked then ' clientEndLocked = true 'else ' newConnector.ClientID = currConnector.ClientID ' newConnector.SupplierID = newElement.ElementID ' clientEndLocked = false 'end if
'end if
if clientEndLocked then
set clientElement = Repository.GetElementByID( currConnector.ClientID)
lockMsg = "Cannot create «" & currConnector.Stereotype & "» " & currConnector.Type lockMsg = lockMsg & " from LOCKED client element '" & clientElement.Name & "' «" & clientElement.Stereotype & "» " & clientElement.Type lockMsg = lockMsg & " to new cloned element."
Session.Output lockMsg
lockError = true
else CopyElementConnector currConnector, newConnector end if
end if
next
newElement.Connectors.Refresh
end if
end sub
function createNewConnector( currConnector, currElement, newElement)
dim newConnectorClientID ' as Integer dim newConnectorSupplierID ' as Integer dim sqlString ' as String dim typeLib ' as Scriptlet.TypeLib dim newGUID ' as String dim newConnector as EA.Connector dim testConnector as EA.Connector
if currConnector.ClientID = currElement.ElementID then newConnectorClientID = newElement.ElementID newConnectorSupplierID = currConnector.SupplierID else newConnectorClientID = currConnector.ClientID newConnectorSupplierID = newElement.ElementID end if
set typeLib = CreateObject( "Scriptlet.TypeLib")
newGUID = typeLib.Guid newGUID = Left( newGUID, Len( newGUID) - 2) ' remove null termination characters at end
sqlString = "INSERT INTO t_connector " sqlString = sqlString & "(Name, Direction, Connector_Type, Start_Object_ID, End_Object_ID, ea_guid, "
if currConnector.Stereotype <> "" then sqlString = sqlString & "Stereotype, " end if
sqlString = sqlString & "PDATA1, PDATA2, PDATA3, PDATA4, PDATA5) " sqlString = sqlString & "VALUES (" sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.Name & "', " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.Direction & "', " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.Type & "', " sqlString = sqlString & newConnectorClientID & ", " sqlString = sqlString & newConnectorSupplierID & ", " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & newGUID & "', "
if currConnector.Stereotype <> "" then sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.Stereotype & "', " end if
sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.MiscData(0) & "', " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.MiscData(1) & "', " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.MiscData(2) & "', " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.MiscData(3) & "', " sqlString = sqlString & "'" & currConnector.MiscData(4) & "')"
Repository.Execute sqlString
set createNewConnector = Repository.GetConnectorByGuid( newGUID)
'currElement.Connectors.Refresh
'set newConnector = nothing
'for each testConnector in currElement.Connectors ' if testConnector.ConnectorGUID = newGUID then ' set newConnector = testConnector ' exit for ' end if 'next
'set createNewConnector = newConnector
end function
sub CopyElementConnector( currConnector, newConnector)
dim clonedGUIDTag as EA.ConnectorTag
newConnector.Alias = currConnector.Alias newConnector.Color = currConnector.Color newConnector.DiagramID = currConnector.DiagramID newConnector.Direction = currConnector.Direction newConnector.EndPointX = currConnector.EndPointX newConnector.EndPointY = currConnector.EndPointY newConnector.EventFlags = currConnector.EventFlags newConnector.IsLeaf = currConnector.IsLeaf newConnector.IsRoot = currConnector.IsRoot newConnector.IsSpec = currConnector.IsSpec newConnector.Notes = currConnector.Notes newConnector.RouteStyle = currConnector.RouteStyle newConnector.SequenceNo = currConnector.SequenceNo newConnector.StartPointX = currConnector.StartPointX newConnector.StartPointY = currConnector.StartPointY newConnector.StateFlags = currConnector.StateFlags newConnector.StereotypeEx = currConnector.StereotypeEx newConnector.StyleEx = currConnector.StyleEx newConnector.Subtype = currConnector.Subtype newConnector.TransitionAction = currConnector.TransitionAction newConnector.TransitionEvent = currConnector.TransitionEvent newConnector.TransitionGuard = currConnector.TransitionGuard newConnector.VirtualInheritance = currConnector.VirtualInheritance newConnector.Width = currConnector.Width
On Error Resume Next
newConnector.Update
if err.Number <> 0 then Session.Output "Error saving cloned connector: " & err.Description end if
On Error Goto 0
CopyConnectorEnd currConnector.ClientEnd, newConnector.ClientEnd CopyConnectorEnd currConnector.SupplierEnd, newConnector.SupplierEnd
'CopyConnectorConstraints CopyConnectorConveyedItems currConnector, newConnector 'CopyConnectorMessageArguments CopyConnectorTaggedValues currConnector, newConnector 'CopyConnectorTemplateBindings
set clonedGUIDTag = newConnector.TaggedValues.GetByName( CLONED_GUID)
if clonedGUIDTag is nothing then set clonedGUIDTag = newConnector.TaggedValues.AddNew( CLONED_GUID, "") end if
clonedGUIDTag.Value = currConnector.ConnectorGUID
clonedGUIDTag.Update
newConnector.TaggedValues.Refresh
end sub
sub CopyConnectorEnd( currConnectorEnd, newConnectorEnd)
newConnectorEnd.Aggregation = currConnectorEnd.Aggregation newConnectorEnd.Alias = currConnectorEnd.Alias newConnectorEnd.AllowDuplicates = currConnectorEnd.AllowDuplicates newConnectorEnd.Cardinality = currConnectorEnd.Cardinality newConnectorEnd.Constraint = currConnectorEnd.Constraint newConnectorEnd.Containment = currConnectorEnd.Containment newConnectorEnd.Derived = currConnectorEnd.Derived newConnectorEnd.DerivedUnion = currConnectorEnd.DerivedUnion newConnectorEnd.IsChangeable = currConnectorEnd.IsChangeable newConnectorEnd.Navigable = currConnectorEnd.Navigable newConnectorEnd.Ordering = currConnectorEnd.Ordering newConnectorEnd.OwnedByClassifier = currConnectorEnd.OwnedByClassifier newConnectorEnd.Qualifier = currConnectorEnd.Qualifier newConnectorEnd.Role = currConnectorEnd.Role newConnectorEnd.RoleNote = currConnectorEnd.RoleNote newConnectorEnd.StereotypeEx = currConnectorEnd.StereotypeEx newConnectorEnd.Visibility = currConnectorEnd.Visibility
newConnectorEnd.Update
end sub
sub CopyConnectorConveyedItems( currConnector, newConnector)
dim conveyedItem as EA.Element
if currConnector.ConveyedItems.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 6, ".") & "Conveyed Items"
for each conveyedItem in currConnector.ConveyedItems newConnector.ConveyedItems.AddNew conveyedItem.ElementGUID, "" next
newConnector.ConveyedItems.Refresh
end if

sub CopyConnectorTaggedValues( currConnector, newConnector)
dim currTaggedValue as EA.ConnectorTag dim newTaggedValue as EA.ConnectorTag
if currConnector.TaggedValues.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 6, ".") & "Tagged Values"
for each currTaggedValue in currConnector.TaggedValues
set newTaggedValue = newConnector.TaggedValues.GetByName( currTaggedValue.Name)
if newTaggedValue is nothing then set newTaggedValue = newConnector.TaggedValues.AddNew( currTaggedValue.Name, "") end if
newTaggedValue.Value = currTaggedValue.Value newTaggedValue.Notes = currTaggedValue.Notes
newTaggedValue.Update
next
newConnector.TaggedValues.Refresh
end if
end sub
sub CopyElementDiagrams( currElement, newElement)
dim currDiagram as EA.Diagram
if currElement.Diagrams.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 2, ".") & "Diagrams"
for each currDiagram in currElement.Diagrams CopyElementDiagram currDiagram, newElement next
newElement.IsComposite = currElement.IsComposite
newElement.Update
newElement.Diagrams.Refresh

sub CopyElementDiagram( currDiagram, newElement)
dim newDiagram as EA.Diagram
Session.Output String( 4, ".") & "Diagram '" & currDiagram.Name
set newDiagram = newElement.Diagrams.AddNew( currDiagram.Name, currDiagram.Type)
newDiagram.cx = currDiagram.cx newDiagram.cy = currDiagram.cy newDiagram.ExtendedStyle = currDiagram.ExtendedStyle newDiagram.FilterElements = currDiagram.FilterElements newDiagram.HighlightImports = currDiagram.HighlightImports newDiagram.Notes = currDiagram.Notes newDiagram.Orientation = currDiagram.Orientation newDiagram.Scale = currDiagram.Scale newDiagram.ShowDetails = currDiagram.ShowDetails newDiagram.ShowPackageContents = currDiagram.ShowPackageContents newDiagram.ShowPrivate = currDiagram.ShowPrivate newDiagram.ShowProtected = currDiagram.ShowProtected newDiagram.ShowPublic = currDiagram.ShowPublic newDiagram.Stereotype = currDiagram.Stereotype newDiagram.StyleEx = currDiagram.StyleEx newDiagram.Version = currDiagram.Version
newDiagram.Update
CopyDiagramObjects currDiagram, newDiagram
CopyDiagramLinks currDiagram, newDiagram
CopyDiagramSwimlanes currDiagram, newDiagram

sub CopyDiagramObjects( currDiagram, newDiagram)
dim currDiagramObject as EA.DiagramObject
if currDiagram.DiagramObjects.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 6, ".") & "Objects"
for each currDiagramObject in currDiagram.DiagramObjects CopyDiagramObject currDiagramObject, newDiagram next
newDiagram.DiagramObjects.Refresh
end if

sub CopyDiagramLinks( currDiagram, newDiagram)
dim currLink as EA.DiagramLink dim newLink as EA.DiagramLink
if currDiagram.DiagramLinks.Count > 0 then
Session.Output String( 6, ".") & "Links"
for each currLink in currDiagram.DiagramLinks
set newLink = CopyDiagramLink( currLink, newDiagram)
newLink.Update
next
newDiagram.DiagramLinks.Refresh

sub CopyDiagramSwimlanes( currDiagram, newDiagram)
dim currSwimlane ' as EA.Swimlane
newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Bold = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Bold newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.FontColor = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.FontColor newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.HideClassifier = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.HideClassifier newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.HideNames = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.HideNames newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.LineColor = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.LineColor newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.LineWidth = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.LineWidth newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Locked = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Locked newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Orientation = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Orientation newDiagram.SwimlaneDef.ShowInTitleBar = currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.ShowInTitleBar

Session.Output String( 6, ".") & "Swimlanes"
for each currSwimlane in currDiagram.SwimlaneDef.Swimlanes CopyDiagramSwimlane currSwimlane, newDiagram next
newDiagram.Update

sub CopyDiagramSwimlane( currSwimlane, newDiagram)

newSwimlane.BackColor = currSwimlane.BackColor newSwimlane.ClassifierGuid = currSwimlane.ClassifierGuid

Column.value: <Script Name="Cloning -> Replace Diagram Element" Type="Internal" Language="VBScript"/>

Column.name: Script
Column.value:
' ' Diagram script to replace the selected element on a diagram with the currently selected element in the ' project browser. '
option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC SSNA Diagram Script Utilities.Clone Routines
sub OnDiagramScript()
dim currDiagram as EA.Diagram dim selectedObjects as EA.Collection dim selectedDiagramObject as EA.DiagramObject dim selectedElements as EA.Collection dim selectedBrowserElement as EA.Element
set currDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram()
if not currDiagram is nothing then
set selectedObjects = currDiagram.SelectedObjects
if selectedObjects.Count = 1 then
set selectedDiagramObject = selectedObjects.GetAt(0)
set selectedElements = Repository.GetTreeSelectedElements
if selectedElements.Count = 1 then
set selectedBrowserElement = selectedElements.GetAt(0)
ReplaceDiagramElement currDiagram, selectedDiagramObject, selectedBrowserElement
else Session.Prompt "This script requires one (and only one) element to be selected in the Project Browser.", promptOK end if
else Session.Prompt "This script requires one (and only one) element to be selected on the diagram.", promptOK end if else Session.Prompt "This script requires a diagram to be visible", promptOK end if
end sub
sub ReplaceDiagramElement( currDiagram, currDiagramObject, newElement)
dim currElement as EA.Element
set currElement = Repository.GetElementByID( currDiagramObject.ElementID)
Repository.EnsureOutputVisible "Script"
Session.Output String( 40, "-") Session.Output "Replacing '" & currElement.Name & "' with '" & newELement.Name & "' on '" & currDiagram.Name & "' ..."
SwapDiagramObject currDiagram, currDiagramObject, currElement, newElement
Session.Output "Finished!"
end sub
OnDiagramScript

Column.name: Notes
Column.value: <Script Name="Clone Routines" Type="Internal" Language="VBScript"/>

Column.name: Script
Column.value:
' Common routines used in cloning and diagram object replacement.
const CLONE_TYPE = "Dependency" ' as String const CLONE_STEREOTYPE = "clone" ' as String const CLONED_GUID = "_clonedGUID" ' as String
dim linkError ' as Boolean
sub SwapDiagramObject( currDiagram, currDiagramObject, currElement, newElement)
dim newDiagramObject as EA.DiagramObject
linkError = false
set newDiagramObject = CopyDiagramObject( currDiagramObject, currDiagram)
newDiagramObject.ElementID = newElement.ElementID
newDiagramObject.Update
CopyClonedDiagramLinks currDiagram, currElement, newElement
DeleteOriginalDiagramObject currDiagram, currDiagramObject
Repository.ReloadDiagram currDiagram.DiagramID
if linkError then Session.Prompt "One or more cloned relationships could not be found." & vbCRLF & vbCRLF & "Examine the Script tab of the System Output window for details.", promptOK end if
end sub
sub CopyClonedDiagramLinks( currDiagram, currElement, newElement)
dim newConnector as EA.Connector dim currConnector as EA.Connector dim currLink as EA.DiagramLink dim currConnectorID ' as Integer dim newLink as EA.DiagramLink
Session.Output String( 2, ".") & "Copying cloned diagram links"
for each newConnector in newElement.Connectors
if newConnector.Type <> CLONE_TYPE and newConnector.Stereotype <> CLONE_STEREOTYPE then
set currConnector = FindElementConnectorByGUID( currElement, newConnector)
if not( currConnector is nothing) then
for each currLink in currDiagram.DiagramLinks
if currLink.ConnectorID = currConnector.ConnectorID then
currLink.IsHidden = true currLink.Update
set newLink = CopyDiagramLink( currLink, currDiagram)
newLink.ConnectorID = newConnector.ConnectorID newLInk.IsHidden = false
newLink.Update
end if
next
end if
end if
next
currDiagram.DiagramLinks.Refresh
end sub
function FindElementConnectorByGUID( currElement, newConnector)
dim clonedConnectorGUIDTag as EA.ConnectorTag dim clonedConnectorGUID ' as String dim currConnector as EA.Connector dim connectorFound ' as Boolean
set clonedConnectorGUIDTag = newConnector.TaggedValues.GetByName( CLONED_GUID)
connectorFound = false
if clonedConnectorGUIDTag is nothing then
Session.Output "Cloned connector GUID tagged value missing from new connector " & newConnector.Type & " " & newConnector.ConnectorGUID & ". Unable to locate original connector."
linkError = true
else
clonedConnectorGUID = clonedConnectorGUIDTag.Value
for each currConnector in currElement.Connectors
if currConnector.ConnectorGUID = clonedConnectorGUID then connectorFound = true exit for end if
next
end if
if connectorFound then set FindElementConnectorByGUID = currConnector else set FindElementConnectorByGUID = nothing end if
end function
sub DeleteOriginalDiagramObject( currDiagram, origDiagramObject)
dim objectCount ' as Integer dim objectIndex ' as Integer dim currDiagramObject as EA.DiagramObject
objectCount = currDiagram.DiagramObjects.Count
for objectIndex = objectCount - 1 to 0 step -1
set currDiagramObject = currDiagram.DiagramObjects.GetAt( objectIndex)
if currDiagramObject.ElementID = origDiagramObject.ElementID then
currDiagram.DiagramObjects.DeleteAt objectIndex, false
exit for
end if
next
currDiagram.DiagramObjects.Refresh
end sub

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript
dim m_packageHierarchyList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim m_extPackageConnList 'as Scripting.Dictionary
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
dim treeSelectedType dim package as EA.Package
treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
select case treeSelectedType
case otPackage
set package = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
startReportExternalPackageDependencies package
case else Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK end select
end sub
sub startReportExternalPackageDependencies( package)
dim packageHierarchyList ' as Scripting.Dictionary
set m_packageHierarchyList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary") set m_extPackageConnList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary")
Session.Output "Report External Package Dependencies (Details)"
Session.Output "- Building package hierarchy list..." buildPackageHierarchyList package
checkPackage package
end sub
sub checkPackage( package)
dim element as EA.Element dim childPackage as EA.Package
Session.Output "- Checking package " & package.Name
checkElement package.Element
for each element in package.Elements checkElement element next
for each childPackage in package.Packages checkPackage childPackage next
reportConnectors package
end sub
sub reportConnectors( package)
dim connector as EA.Connector dim sourceElement as EA.Element dim targetElement as EA.Element dim sourcePackageID 'as Integer dim targetPackageID 'as Integer dim connDirection 'as String dim relatedElement as EA.Element dim connElementList 'as EA.Connector() dim sourcePackage as EA.Package dim targetPackage as EA.Package
Session.output vbCRLF
if m_extPackageConnList.Count = 0 then Session.Output "'" & package.Name & "': There are no external package dependencies for any elements." else
Session.Output "'" & package.Name & "' External Package Dependencies"
connElementList = m_extPackageConnList.Items
for each connector in connElementList
set sourceElement = Repository.GetElementByID( connector.ClientID) set targetElement = Repository.GetElementByID( connector.SupplierID)
sourcePackageID = sourceElement.PackageID targetPackageID = targetElement.PackageID
if m_packageHierarchyList.Exists( sourcePackageID) = false then connDirection = "<- FROM" else connDirection = "TO ->" end if
set sourcePackage = Repository.GetPackageByID( sourcePackageID) set targetPackage = Repository.GetPackageByID( targetPackageID)
Session.Output "- " & sourcePackage.Element.FQName & ":" & sourceElement.Name & " " & connDirection & " " & targetPackage.Name & ":" & targetElement.Name
next
end if
end sub
sub checkElement( element)
dim childElement as EA.Element dim connector as EA.Connector
for each connector in element.Connectors checkConnector element, connector next
for each childElement in element.Elements checkElement childElement next
end sub
sub checkConnector( element, connector)
dim relatedElementID 'as Integer dim relatedElement as EA.Element dim relatedPackageID 'as Integer
if element.ElementID = connector.ClientID then relatedElementID = connector.SupplierID else relatedElementID = connector.ClientID end if
set relatedElement = Repository.GetElementByID( relatedElementID)
relatedPackageID = relatedElement.PackageID
if m_packageHierarchyList.Exists( relatedPackageID) = false then m_extPackageConnList.Add connector.ConnectorID, connector end if
end sub
sub buildPackageHierarchyList( package)
dim childPackage as EA.Package
m_packageHierarchyList.Add package.PackageID, package
for each childPackage in package.Packages buildPackageHierarchyList childPackage next
end sub

' Roadmap Diagram Generator option explicit
' Include EA constants and utilities !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Create Nested Hierarchy Diagram !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Color Constants
' Entry point: invoked on selected package Sub OnProjectBrowserScript() Dim itemType Dim rootPkg As EA.Package Dim levelList ' Dictionary of HierarchyLevel Dim childPkg As EA.Package Dim elm As EA.Element
itemType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() If itemType <> otPackage Then Session.Prompt "Please select a package to generate the roadmap.", promptOK Exit Sub End If
' Get the selected package Set rootPkg = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() Session.Output "Generating roadmap for package: " & rootPkg.Name
' Prepare the hierarchy levels Set levelList = getDiagramLevelList()
' Create one diagram under the root package createNestedHierarchyDiagram rootPkg, levelList, "RoadmapDiagram", False
Session.Output "Roadmap diagram created." End Sub
' Define the hierarchy levels: Roadmap → Phase → Milestone Function getDiagramLevelList() Dim levels Dim lvl1, lvl2, lvl3
Set levels = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
' Level 1: Roadmap container Set lvl1 = New HierarchyLevel lvl1.numObjects = 1 lvl1.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION lvl1.elementMetatype = "Program" ' expects sub-package with stereotype 'Roadmap' lvl1.horizOffset = 20 lvl1.horizSpace = 20 lvl1.vertOffset = 20 lvl1.vertSpace = 20 lvl1.objectWidth = 400 lvl1.objectHeight = 100 lvl1.objectStyle.fillColor = colorWhite lvl1.objectStyle.fontSize = 16 lvl1.objectStyle.fontName = "Calibri" lvl1.objectStyle.fontBold = "1" levels.Add 1, lvl1
' Level 2: Phases Set lvl2 = New HierarchyLevel lvl2.numObjects = 4 ' e.g. Q1-Q4 lvl2.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION lvl2.elementMetatype = "Growth Package" ' expects sub-package with stereotype 'Phase' lvl2.horizOffset = 10 lvl2.horizSpace = 10 lvl2.vertOffset = 120 lvl2.vertSpace = 10 lvl2.objectWidth = 180 lvl2.objectHeight = 60 lvl2.objectStyle.fillColor = colorLightSkyBlue lvl2.objectStyle.fontSize = 12 lvl2.objectStyle.fontBold = "1" levels.Add 2, lvl2
' Level 3: Milestones Set lvl3 = New HierarchyLevel lvl3.numObjects = 6 lvl3.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION lvl3.elementMetatype = "Initiative" ' expects elements with stereotype 'Milestone' lvl3.horizOffset = 10 lvl3.horizSpace = 10 lvl3.vertOffset = 200 lvl3.vertSpace = 10 lvl3.objectWidth = 120 lvl3.objectHeight = 40 lvl3.objectStyle.fillColor = colorDeepSkyBlue lvl3.objectStyle.fontSize = 10 lvl3.objectStyle.fontColor = colorWhite lvl3.objectStyle.fontBold = "1" levels.Add 3, lvl3
Set getDiagramLevelList = levels End Function

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Diagram Script Utilities.Set Current Diagram Objects Style
dim m_packageHierarchyList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim m_extPackageList 'as Scripting.Dictionary
const PACKAGE_WIDTH = 130 const PACKAGE_HEIGHT = 80 const PACKAGE_OFFSET = 20 const PACKAGE_HORIZ_SPACING = 20 const PACKAGE_VERT_SPACING = 150
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
dim treeSelectedType dim package as EA.Package
treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
select case treeSelectedType
case otPackage
set package = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
startReportExternalPackageDependencies package
case else Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK end select
end sub
sub startReportExternalPackageDependencies( package)
dim packageHierarchyList ' as Scripting.Dictionary
set m_packageHierarchyList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary") set m_extPackageList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary")
Session.Output "Report External Package Dependencies (Summary)"
Session.Output "- Building package hierarchy list..."
buildPackageHierarchyList package
deletePackageDependencies package
checkPackage package
reportPackages package
end sub
sub checkPackage( package)
dim element as EA.Element dim childPackage as EA.Package
Session.Output "- Checking package " & package.Name
checkElement package.Element
for each element in package.Elements checkElement element next
for each childPackage in package.Packages checkPackage childPackage next
end sub
sub reportPackages( package)
dim packageDiagram as EA.Diagram dim diagramObject as EA.DiagramObject dim dependConn as EA.Connector dim packageList 'as List( Of EA.Package) dim packageIndex 'as Integer dim packageKeyList 'as Object() dim packageKey 'as String dim extPackage as EA.Package dim connDirection 'as String dim extPackageElement as EA.Element dim fqName 'as String dim prevPackageRight 'as Integer
Session.output vbCRLF
if m_extPackageList.Count = 0 then Session.Output "'" & package.Name & "': There are no external package dependencies for any elements." else
Session.Output "'" & package.Name & "' External Package Dependencies"
set packageDiagram = package.Diagrams.AddNew("Package Dependencies", "Package")
packageDiagram.ShowPackageContents = false packageDiagram.StyleEx = UpdateStyleList( packageDiagram.StyleEx, "ShowFQN=1") packageDiagram.Update
set diagramObject = packageDiagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew( "", "")
diagramObject.ElementID = package.Element.ElementID diagramObject.left = PACKAGE_OFFSET diagramObject.top = - PACKAGE_OFFSET diagramObject.right = diagramObject.left + PACKAGE_WIDTH diagramObject.bottom = diagramObject.top - PACKAGE_HEIGHT
diagramObject.Update
prevPackageRight = 0
packageKeyList = m_extPackageList.Keys
for packageIndex = 0 to m_extPackageList.Count - 1
packageKey = packageKeyList( packageIndex)
set extPackage = m_extPackageList.Item( packageKey) set extPackageElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid( extPackage.PackageGUID)
connDirection = Mid( packageKey, InStr( packageKey, ":") + 1)
fqName = Repository.GetFormattedName( extPackage.PackageGUID, &H01 or &H02 or &H04 or &H08 or &H10 or &H20 or &H40 or &H80 , "::", 0)
Session.Output "- " & connDirection & " '" & extPackage.Name & "' (" & fqName & ")"
set dependConn = package.Element.Connectors.AddNew( "", "Package")
if connDirection = "TO" then dependConn.ClientID = package.Element.ElementID dependConn.SupplierID = extPackageElement.ElementID else dependConn.ClientID = extPackageElement.ElementID dependConn.SupplierID = package.Element.ElementID end if
dependConn.Stereotype = "import"
dependConn.Update
set diagramObject = packageDiagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew( "", "")
diagramObject.ElementID = extPackageElement.ElementID diagramObject.left = prevPackageRight + PACKAGE_OFFSET + PACKAGE_HORIZ_SPACING diagramObject.top = - PACKAGE_OFFSET - PACKAGE_HEIGHT - PACKAGE_VERT_SPACING diagramObject.right = diagramObject.left + PACKAGE_WIDTH diagramObject.bottom = diagramObject.top - PACKAGE_HEIGHT
diagramObject.Update packageDiagram.Update
Repository.ReloadDiagram packageDiagram.DiagramID
prevPackageRight = diagramObject.right
next
Repository.SaveDiagram packageDiagram.DiagramID
end if
end sub
sub deletePackageDependencies( package)
dim conn as EA.Connector dim connIndex 'as Integer
for connIndex = package.Connectors.Count - 1 to 0 step -1
set conn = package.Connectors.GetAt( connIndex)
if conn.Type = "Package" and conn.Stereotype = "import" then package.Connectors.Delete( connIndex) end if
next
package.Update
end sub
sub checkElement( element)
dim childElement as EA.Element dim connector as EA.Connector
Session.Output " + " & element.Name
for each connector in element.Connectors checkConnector element, connector next
for each childElement in element.Elements checkElement childElement next
end sub
sub checkConnector( element, connector)
dim relatedElementID 'as Integer dim relatedElement as EA.Element dim relatedPackageID 'as Integer dim relatedPackage as EA.Package dim connDirection 'as String dim packageKey 'as String
if element.ElementID = connector.ClientID then relatedElementID = connector.SupplierID connDirection = "TO" else relatedElementID = connector.ClientID connDirection = "FROM" end if
Session.Output " -> " & connector.ConnectorGUID & " " & connDirection & " " & relatedElementID
set relatedElement = Repository.GetElementByID( relatedElementID)
relatedPackageID = relatedElement.PackageID
if m_packageHierarchyList.Exists( relatedPackageID) = false then
packageKey = CStr(relatedPackageID) & ":" & connDirection
if m_extPackageList.Exists( packageKey) = false then
set relatedPackage = Repository.GetPackageByID( relatedPackageID)
m_extPackageList.Add packageKey, relatedPackage
end if
end if
end sub
sub buildPackageHierarchyList( package)
dim childPackage as EA.Package
m_packageHierarchyList.Add package.PackageID, package
for each childPackage in package.Packages buildPackageHierarchyList childPackage next
end sub

option explicit
' Copyright (c) 2019 Sparx Services North America. www.sparxsystems.us
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC BIZBOK Report Scripts.Report Script Library !INC SSNA Diagram Script Utilities.Color Constants !INC SSNA Diagram Script Utilities.Set Current Diagram Objects Style !INC SSNA Diagram Script Utilities.Clone Routines
dim m_sqlStringTemplate 'as String dim m_countryCode 'as String
const APP_PACKAGE_ID = 5182 const SCALING_FACTOR = 2
const SOLID_FILL_BORDER_STYLE = 0 const SOLID_NOFILL_BORDER_STYLE = 3 const LINE_HEIGHT = 13 ' 8pt font = 13 pixels tall const TEXT_BOX_MARGIN = 5 ' 8pt font = 5 pixels top & bottom const PIXELS_PER_CHAR = 5 ' 8pt font = 5 pixels wide
sub createTAMApplicationMap( packageGUID, templateDiagramGUID, sqlElementGUID, diagramSuffix)
dim templateDiagram as EA.Diagram dim newDiagram as EA.Diagram dim package as EA.Package dim diagramObject as EA.DiagramObject dim elementID 'as Integer dim element as EA.Element dim customStyleList 'as String
m_sqlStringTemplate = GetMappedApplicationsSQLString( sqlElementGUID) set templateDiagram = Repository.GetDiagramByGuid( templateDiagramGUID) set package = Repository.GetPackageByGUID( packageGUID)
Session.Output "Copying template diagram..."
set newDiagram = CopyElementDiagram( templateDiagram, package)
newDiagram.Name = newDiagram.Name & " " & diagramSuffix
Session.Output "Scaling diagram..."
ScaleDiagram newDiagram, SCALING_FACTOR
Session.Output "Add Applications to TAM Diagram '" & newDiagram.name & "'"
for each diagramObject in newDiagram.DiagramObjects
elementID = diagramObject.ElementID set element = Repository.GetElementByID( elementID) Session.Output "Processing diagram element '" & element.Name & "' " & element.Stereotype customStyleList = "SSJ=12:" ' Name - Top Center
setDiagramObjectCustomStyle newDiagram, diagramObject, customStyleList
if element.Stereotype = "TMF_Application" then updateDiagramObject package, newDiagram, diagramObject, element end if
next
newDiagram.StyleEx = UpdateStyleList( newDiagram.StyleEx, "DSO=1") newDiagram.ExtendedStyle = UpdateStyleList( newDiagram.ExtendedStyle, "HideEStereo=1") newDiagram.Update Repository.ReloadDiagram newDiagram.DiagramID
Session.Output "Finished!"
end sub
sub updateDiagramObject( package, diagram, diagramObject, element)
dim boundaryElement as EA.Element dim boundaryObject as EA.DiagramObject dim boundaryStyleList 'as String dim completeAppList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim appNameList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim appNameKeys 'as String() dim appArray 'as Object() dim application as EA.Element dim appCount 'as Integer dim appName 'as String dim appNameText 'as String dim textMaxLines 'as Integer dim columnCount 'as Integer dim columnWidth 'as Integer dim columnIndex 'as Integer dim appIndex 'as Integer dim textObject as EA.DiagramObject dim textElement as EA.Element dim objIndex 'as Integer dim topOffset 'as Integer dim boundaryHeight 'as Integer dim textHeight 'as Integer dim maxTextLength 'as Integer
Session.Output "'" & element.Name & "' TAM Application"
objIndex = -1
set boundaryElement = package.Elements.AddNew( "", "Boundary")
boundaryElement.Update
setElementBorderStyle boundaryElement, SOLID_FILL_BORDER_STYLE
set boundaryObject = diagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew( "", "")
boundaryObject.ElementID = boundaryElement.ElementID boundaryObject.top = diagramObject.top - 20 boundaryObject.bottom = diagramObject.bottom + 5 boundaryObject.left = diagramObject.left + 5 boundaryObject.right = diagramObject.right - 5 boundaryObject.Sequence = objIndex
boundaryStyleList = "BCol=" & colorWhite & ";LCol=" & colorWhite
SetDiagramObjectStyleList boundaryObject, boundaryStyleList
boundaryObject.Update
objIndex = objIndex - 1
set appNameList = getMappedAppNameList( element)
appCount = appNameList.Count
if appCount > 0 then
boundaryHeight = boundaryObject.top - boundaryObject.bottom
textMaxLines = Int( ( boundaryHeight - TEXT_BOX_MARGIN ) / LINE_HEIGHT)
if textMaxLines = 0 then textMaxLines = 1 end if
textHeight = textMaxLines * LINE_HEIGHT + TEXT_BOX_MARGIN * 2
if boundaryHeight <> textHeight then topOffset = ( textHeight - boundaryHeight ) / 2 else topOffset = 0 end if
columnCount = Int( ( ( appCount - 1 ) / textMaxLines) + 1 )
Session.Output element.Name & ": appCount = " & appCount & ", textMaxLines = " & textMaxLines & ", columnCount = " & columnCount
columnWidth = Int( ( boundaryObject.right - boundaryObject.left ) / columnCount)
maxTextLength = Int( columnWidth / PIXELS_PER_CHAR)
appIndex = 0
for columnIndex = 1 to columnCount
set textElement = package.Elements.AddNew( "", "Text")
textElement.Update
set textObject = diagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew( "", "")
textObject.ElementID = textElement.ElementID textObject.top = boundaryObject.top + topOffset textObject.bottom = boundaryObject.bottom textObject.left = boundaryObject.left + ( columnIndex - 1) * columnWidth textObject.right = textObject.left + columnWidth textObject.Sequence = objIndex
textObject.Update
appNameText = ""
do
appNameKeys = appNameList.Keys()
appName = appNameKeys( appIndex)
Session.Output "- Application '" & appName & "'..."
if ( len( appName) * PIXELS_PER_CHAR ) > columnWidth then appName = Left( appName, maxTextLength - 1) & "..." end if
if appNameText = vbNullString then appNameText = appName else appNameText = appNameText & vbCRLF & appName end if
appIndex = appIndex + 1
loop until ( ( appIndex mod textMaxLines) = 0) or appIndex = appCount
textElement.Notes = appNameText
textElement.Update
objIndex = objIndex - 1
next
end if
end sub
function getMappedAppNameList( tamApp)
dim sqlString 'as String dim elementList_XML 'ss String dim elementList_XMLDoc 'as Xml.XmlDocument dim element_XMLNodeList 'as Xml.XmlNodeList dim element_XMLNode 'as Xml.XmlNode dim appNameList 'as SortedList dim childNodeList 'as Xml.XmlNodeList dim appName 'as String dim appGUID 'as String
sqlString = Replace( m_sqlStringTemplate, "%TAM_APP_GUID%", tamApp.ElementGUID) sqlString = Replace( sqlString, "%COUNTRY_CODE%", m_countryCode)
elementList_XML = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlString)
set elementList_XMLDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM")
elementList_XMLDoc.LoadXml(elementList_XML)
set element_XMLNodeList = elementList_XMLDoc.SelectNodes("/EADATA/Dataset_0/Data/Row")
set appNameList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary")
for each element_XMLNode in element_XMLNodeList
set childNodeList = element_XMLNode.ChildNodes
appName = childNodeList.Item(2).Text appGUID = childNodeList.Item(3).Text
appNameList.Add appName, appGUID
next
set getMappedAppNameList = appNameList
end function
function getMappedApplicationsSQLString( sqlElementGUID)
dim sqlElement as EA.Element dim sqlString 'as String
set sqlElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid( sqlElementGUID)
sqlString = sqlElement.Notes
getMappedApplicationsSQLString = sqlString
end function
'DEPRECATED function getMappedApplicationListEA( element, parentAppList)
dim appList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim appIndex 'as Integer dim appName 'as String dim childElement as EA.Element dim childAppList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim childAppIndex 'as Integer dim childAppName 'as String
set appList = getSortedRelatedElementList( element, "Association", "ArchiMate_Assignment", "Component", "ArchiMate_ApplicationComponent", APP_PACKAGE_ID)
for appIndex = 0 to appList.Count - 1
appName = appList.GetKey( appIndex)
if not parentAppList.ContainsKey( appName) then parentAppList.Add appName, appList( appName) end if
next
for each childElement in element.Elements
set childAppList = getMappedApplicationList( childElement, parentAppList)
for childAppIndex = 0 to childAppList.Count - 1
childAppName = childAppList.GetKey( childAppIndex)

option explicit
' Scripts to populate element tagged values from user-defined. WIP
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC TM Forum Scripts.Utility Scripts
const CW_DATA_TYPE_LOOKUP1 = "7" const CW_DATA_TYPE_LOOKUP2 = "9"
dim metamodelPropertyList 'as Scripting.Dictionary
populateElementProperties "{528F1124-6C38-4822-86CF-8DECFFED8B36}" ' Business Processes 'populateElementProperties "{ED525874-1825-41a4-AD9E-3E97C73AF111}" ' Process 'populateElementProperties "{4001E562-BC3A-40db-9D8A-1619B1BE37F2}" ' Metrics 'populateElementProperties "{DB857CCA-C67C-4438-837F-4ADBF5262897}" ' TAM 'populateElementProperties "{CA3C3C3B-361A-46e6-9DC1-DB94AC483E00}" ' Touchpoints
sub populateElementProperties(topPackageGUID)
dim topPackage as EA.Package
set metamodelPropertyList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary")
Session.Output vbCRLF & "Populating Element tagged values from CW user-defined properties...."
set topPackage = Repository.GetPackageByGuid(topPackageGUID)
updatePackageElements topPackage, 0
Session.Output vbCRLF & "Finished!"
end sub
sub updatePackageElements( package, level)
dim element as EA.Element dim childPackage as EA.Package
Session.Output String(level * 2, ".") & "Package '" & package.Name & "'..."
level = level + 1
for each element in package.Elements updateElement element, level next
for each childPackage in package.Packages updatePackageElements childPackage, level next
level = level - 1
end sub
sub updateElement( element, level)
dim taggedValue as EA.TaggedValue dim xmlString 'as String dim xmlDoc 'as XMLDOM dim nodeList 'as XMLNodeList dim propNode 'as XMLNode dim propName 'as String dim propValue 'as String dim childElement as EA.Element
set taggedValue = element.TaggedValues.GetByName("USERDEFINED")
if taggedValue is nothing then Session.Output String(level * 2, ".") & "<<" & element.Stereotype & ">> " & element.Name & " [" & element.Type & "] - No USERDEFINED properties; Skipping..." else
Session.Output String(level * 2, ".") & element.Name & " element - Processing USERDEFINED properties..."
xmlString = taggedValue.Notes
set xmlDoc = CreateObject( "Microsoft.XMLDOM")
xmlDoc.Async = false xmlDoc.LoadXML xmlString
set nodeList = xmlDoc.SelectNodes("//property")
for each propNode in nodeList
propName = propNode.GetAttribute( "scriptname") propValue = propNode.Text
setElementPropertyValue element, propName, propValue
next
level = level + 1
for each childElement in element.Elements updateElement childElement, level next
level = level - 1
end if
end sub
sub setElementPropertyValue( element, propName, propValue)
dim propList 'as Dictionary dim dataType 'as String dim classProp as EA.Element dim lookupValueElement as EA.Element
set propList = getMetamodelPropertyList( element.Stereotype)
if propList.Exists( propName) then
set classProp = propList.Item( propName)
dataType = getElementTaggedValueValue( classProp, "PPT_DATA_TYPE")
if dataType = CW_DATA_TYPE_LOOKUP1 or dataType = CW_DATA_TYPE_LOOKUP2 then
set lookupValueElement = lookupElementTaggedValue( "LU_ID", propValue, "lookupValue", "Part")
propValue = lookupValueElement.Name
end if
setElementTaggedValueValue element, classProp.Name, propValue
else Session.Output "***ERROR*** No metamodel class mapping property found for '" & propName & "'" end if
end sub
function getMetamodelPropertyList( stereotype)
dim metamodelClassName 'as String dim metamodelElement as EA.Element dim propList 'as Scripting.Dictionary dim classProp 'as String dim propName 'as String
select case stereotype case "TMF_Application" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Application" case "TMF_Function" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Function" case "TMF_Domain" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Domain" case "ArchiMate_BusinessInteraction" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Business Scenario" case "TMF_Metric" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Metric" case "TMF_BusinessProcess" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Process" case "ArchiMate_BusinessService" metamodelClassName = "Frameworx Touchpoint" case "ArchiMate_BusinessProcess" metamodelClassName = "Process" case else metamodelClassName = vbNullString end select
if metamodelClassName = vbNullString then Session.Output "***ERROR*** No metamodel class mapping for stereotype '" & stereotype & "'" set propList = nothing else
if metamodelPropertyList.Exists( stereotype) then set propList = metamodelPropertyList.Item( stereotype) else
Session.Output "Building property list for '" & stereotype & "'..."
set metamodelElement = lookupElementName( metamodelClassName, vbNullString, "Class")
set propList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary")
for each classProp in metamodelElement.Elements
propName = getElementTaggedValueValue( classProp, "PPT_SCRPT_NAME")
if propName <> vbNullString then propList.Add propName, classProp end if
next
metamodelPropertyList.Add stereotype, propList
end if
end if
set getMetamodelPropertyList = propList
end function

function lookupElementName(lookupValue, lookupStereotype, lookupElementType)
dim sqlString ' As String dim elementList_XML ' As String dim elementList_XMLDoc ' As Xml.XmlDocument dim element_XMLNodeList ' As Xml.XmlNodeList dim element_XMLNode ' As Xml.XmlNode dim elementGUID ' As String dim lookupColumnName ' As String dim lookupElement as EA.Element
sqlString = "SELECT ea_guid FROM t_object" sqlString = sqlString & " WHERE t_object.Name = '" & lookupValue & "'"
If lookupStereotype = vbNullString Then sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_object.Stereotype Is Null" Else sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_object.Stereotype = '" & lookupStereotype & "'" End If
sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_object.Object_Type = '" & lookupElementType & "'"
elementList_XML = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlString)
set elementList_XMLDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM")
elementList_XMLDoc.LoadXml(elementList_XML)
set element_XMLNodeList = elementList_XMLDoc.SelectNodes("/EADATA/Dataset_0/Data/Row")
If element_XMLNodeList.Length > 0 Then
set element_XMLNode = element_XMLNodeList.Item(0) elementGUID = element_XMLNode.FirstChild.Text set lookupElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid(elementGUID)
Else set lookupElement = Nothing End If
set lookupElementName = lookupElement
end function
function lookupElementTaggedValue(taggedValueName, lookupValue, lookupStereotype, lookupElementType)
dim sqlString ' As String dim elementList_XML ' As String dim elementList_XMLDoc ' As Xml.XmlDocument dim element_XMLNodeList ' As Xml.XmlNodeList dim element_XMLNode ' As Xml.XmlNode dim elementGUID ' As String dim lookupColumnName ' As String dim lookupElement as EA.Element
sqlString = "SELECT t_object.ea_guid" sqlString = sqlString & " FROM t_object" sqlString = sqlString & " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties ON t_object.Object_ID = t_objectproperties.Object_ID" sqlString = sqlString & " WHERE t_objectproperties.Property = '" & taggedValueName & "'" sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_objectproperties.Value = '" & lookupValue & "'"
If lookupStereotype = vbNullString Then sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_object.Stereotype Is Null" Else sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_object.Stereotype = '" & lookupStereotype & "'" End If sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_object.Object_Type = '" & lookupElementType & "'" elementList_XML = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlString) set elementList_XMLDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM") elementList_XMLDoc.LoadXml(elementList_XML) set element_XMLNodeList = elementList_XMLDoc.SelectNodes("/EADATA/Dataset_0/Data/Row") If element_XMLNodeList.Length > 0 Then set element_XMLNode = element_XMLNodeList.Item(0) elementGUID = element_XMLNode.FirstChild.Text set lookupElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid(elementGUID) Else set lookupElement = Nothing End If set lookupElementTaggedValue = lookupElement end function
function getConnectorGUIDListTaggedValue(taggedValueName, lookupValue, lookupStereotype, lookupConnectorType)
dim connGUIDList() ' As String dim sqlString ' As String dim connList_XML ' As String dim connList_XMLDoc ' As Xml.XmlDocument dim conn_XMLNodeList ' As Xml.XmlNodeList dim conn_XMLNode ' As Xml.XmlNode dim connIndex ' As Integer dim connGUID ' As String
sqlString = "SELECT t_connector.ea_guid" sqlString = sqlString & " FROM t_connector" sqlString = sqlString & " INNER JOIN t_connectortag ON t_connector.Connector_ID = t_connectortag.ElementID" sqlString = sqlString & " WHERE t_connectortag.Property = '" & taggedValueName & "'" sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_connectortag.Value = '" & lookupValue & "'"
If lookupStereotype <> vbNullString Then sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_connector.Stereotype = '" & lookupStereotype & "'" End If if lookupConnectorType <> vbNullString then sqlString = sqlString & " AND t_connector.Connector_Type = '" & lookupConnectorType & "'" end if connList_XML = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlString) set connList_XMLDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM") connList_XMLDoc.LoadXml(connList_XML) set conn_XMLNodeList = connList_XMLDoc.SelectNodes("/EADATA/Dataset_0/Data/Row") connIndex = 0 for each conn_XMLNode in conn_XMLNodeList connGUID = conn_XMLNode.FirstChild.Text redim preserve connGUIDList( connIndex + 1) connGUIDList( connIndex) = connGUID connIndex = connIndex + 1 next getConnectorGUIDListTaggedValue = connGUIDList end function
sub setElementPDATA(element, pdataIndex, pdataValue) 'PDATA1 ' For Package elements: primary key of the package ' For Elements: Same as the Status column ' For Parts/Instances: GUID of the classifier ' For UseCase: #EXP#=<ep>; semi-colon separated list of Extension Points <ep> ' For Notes: linked element feature name ' For Text displaying as hyperlink: t_diagram.Diagram_ID ' For Requirements: Status property ' For UMLDiagram: Diagram_ID of the underlying diagram; ' If Object_Type is one of Activity, Artifact, Class, Interaction, Requirement, State, 'StateMachine, UseCase (and probably some more) and NType is 8 and PDATA1 has a number 'greater then zero then PDATA1 corresponds to t_diagram.Diagram_ID of the composite 'diagram. 'if NType is 82 diagram hyperlink; PDATA1 == t_diagram.Diagram_ID ' ' PDATA2 ' For Elements: Same as the Priority column ' For Notes: Object_ID of the linked feature element ' For Requirements: Priority property
' PDATA3 ' For Elements: Same as the Difficulty column ' For Notes: Reference name into the linked feature element ' For Ports in classified Parts: the GUID of the corresponding Port in the Classifier. ' For State: t_diagram.Diagram_ID of the composite diagram ' For Requirements: Difficulty property
' PDATA4 ' For Note elements: Yes if the note is linked to an element feature and idref=<val>; list where <val> is the primary key of the connector(s) to which the note is linked ' For elements: If > 0 this is the primary key of the connector for which this element is defines as association class
' PDATA5 Keywords property
Dim sqlString 'As String Dim pdataColumnName 'As String pdataColumnName = "PDATA" & pdataIndex sqlString = "UPDATE t_object SET " & pdataColumnName & "='" & pdataValue & "' WHERE Object_ID = " & element.ElementID Repository.Execute( sqlString) element.Refresh End Sub

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Frameworx Scripts.Utility Scripts

sub populateConnectorProperties( objectTypeID, propName, typeTaggedValueName)

Session.Output vbCRLF & "Populating Connector tagged values from CW properties...."
connGUIDList = getConnectorGUIDListTaggedValue( "OT_ID", objectTypeID, vbNullString, vbNullString)
createLookupValueList objectTypeID, propName

set connector = Repository.GetConnectorByGuid( connGUID)
Session.Output "Connector: " & connector.ConnectorGUID
updateConnector connector, propName, typeTaggedValueName

sub updateConnector( connector, propName, typeTaggedValueName)
' No need to have code for USERDEFINED XML property as none of the CW relationship ' that need to be imported have non-null values.
dim lookupValueID 'as String dim lookupValueName 'as String
lookupValueID = getConnectorTaggedValueValue( connector, typeTaggedValueName)
if lookupValueID <> vbNullString then
if lookupValueList.Exists( lookupValueID) then
lookupValueName = lookupValueList.Item( lookupValueID)
setConnectorTaggedValueValue connector, propName, lookupValueName
Session.Output "..Set '" & propName & "' to '" & lookupValueName
else Session.Output "***ERROR*** No lookup value found for '" & lookupValueID & "' for '" & propName & "'" end if
end if
end sub
sub createLookupValueList( objectTypeID, propName)
dim metamodelElement as EA.Element dim propElement as EA.Element dim propID 'as String dim lookupTypeElement as EA.Element dim lookupValueElement as EA.Element dim lookupValue 'as String
Session.Output "Building lookup value list for property '" & propName & "' for CW Object Type '" & objectTypeID & "'..."
set lookupValueList = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary")
set metamodelElement = lookupElementTaggedValue( "OT_ID", objectTypeID, vbNullString, "Class")
for each propElement in metamodelElement.Elements
if propElement.Name = propName then
propID = getElementTaggedValueValue( propElement, "PPT_ID")
set lookupTypeElement = lookupElementTaggedValue( "PPT_ID", propID, "lookupType", "Class")
for each lookupValueElement in lookupTypeElement.Elements
lookupValue = getElementTaggedValueValue( lookupValueElement, "LU_ID")
lookupValueList.Add lookupValue, lookupValueElement.Name
next
exit for
end if
next
end sub

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC TM Forum Scripts.Utility Scripts ' util - create Diagram Hyperlinks ' Script to create hyperlinks to child diagrams for TMF hyperlink stereotypes (i.e. TMF_CategoryHyperlink) ' on top level diagrams (i.e. Application Framework Level 1 Overview). WIP
dim diagramGUID 'as string diagramGUID = "{61BAFBF9-2981-4cac-A497-58FD47F2D2E8}" setDiagramHyperlinks diagramGUID
sub setDiagramHyperlinks( diagramGUID)
dim diagram as EA.Diagram dim diagramObject as EA.DiagramObject dim elementID 'as Integer dim diagramElement as EA.Element
set diagram = Repository.GetDiagramByGuid( diagramGUID) Session.Output "Set diagram hyperlinks for '" & diagram.name & "'...." for each diagramObject in diagram.DiagramObjects elementID = diagramObject.ElementID set diagramElement = Repository.GetElementByID( elementID)
select case diagramElement.Stereotype case "TMF_CategoryHyperlink" setObjectHyperlink diagramElement, "Class", "Frameworx Category" case "TMF_DomainHyperlink" setObjectHyperlink diagramElement, "Class", "Frameworx Domain" case else Session.Output "- Skipping <<" & diagramElement.Stereotype & ">> '" & diagramElement.Name & "'..." end select
next
end sub
sub setObjectHyperlink( diagramElement, objType, stereotype)
dim taggedValue as EA.TaggedValue dim OT_ID 'as string dim GO_ID 'as string dim parentElement as EA.Element dim childDiagram as EA.Diagram
Session.Output "- Setting hyperlink for '" & diagramElement.Name & "'..."
set taggedValue = diagramElement.TaggedValues.GetByName( "OT_ID") if taggedValue is nothing then OT_ID = "" else OT_ID = taggedValue.Value end if
set taggedValue = diagramElement.TaggedValues.GetByName( "GO_ID") if taggedValue is nothing then GO_ID = "" else GO_ID = taggedValue.Value end if if OT_ID <> "" and GO_ID <> "" then set parentElement = getParentElement( OT_ID, GO_ID, objType, stereotype) if parentElement.Diagrams.Count > 0 then set childDiagram = parentElement.Diagrams.GetAt(0) diagramElement.Notes = diagramElement.Name diagramElement.Name = "$diagram://" & childDiagram.DiagramGUID diagramElement.ParentID = parentElement.ElementID diagramElement.Update setElementPDATA diagramElement, 1, childDiagram.DiagramID end if end if end sub
function getParentElement( OT_ID, GO_ID, objType, stereotype)
dim sqlString ' As String dim elementList_XML ' As String dim elementList_XMLDoc ' As Xml.XmlDocument dim element_XMLNodeList ' As Xml.XmlNodeList dim element_XMLNode ' As Xml.XmlNode dim elementGUID ' As String dim parentElement as EA.Element
sqlString = "SELECT t_object.ea_guid FROM (t_object" sqlString = sqlString & " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS OT_ID_Prop ON t_object.Object_ID = OT_ID_Prop.Object_ID)" sqlString = sqlString & " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS GO_ID_Prop ON t_object.Object_ID = GO_ID_Prop.Object_ID" sqlString = sqlString & " WHERE (((OT_ID_Prop.Property)='OT_ID')" sqlString = sqlString & " AND ((OT_ID_Prop.Value)='" & OT_ID & "')" sqlString = sqlString & " AND ((GO_ID_Prop.Property)='GO_ID')" sqlString = sqlString & " AND ((GO_ID_Prop.Value)='" & GO_ID & "')" sqlString = sqlString & " AND ((t_object.Stereotype)='" & stereotype & "')" sqlString = sqlString & " AND ((t_object.Object_Type)='" & objType & "'))"
elementList_XML = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlString) set elementList_XMLDoc = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLDOM") elementList_XMLDoc.LoadXml(elementList_XML) set element_XMLNodeList = elementList_XMLDoc.SelectNodes("/EADATA/Dataset_0/Data/Row") If element_XMLNodeList.Length > 0 Then set element_XMLNode = element_XMLNodeList.Item(0) elementGUID = element_XMLNode.FirstChild.Text set parentElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid(elementGUID) Else set parentElement = Nothing End If
set getParentElement = parentElement
end function

sub startMigration dim packageGUID 'as String dim package as EA.Package packageGUID = "{64C7CCBF-9923-49d5-9ABB-F8A50A26F398}" set package = Repository.GetPackageByGuid( packageGUID) migratePackage package end sub

sub migrateElement( element)
dim childElement as EA.Element dim objTypeTV as EA.TaggedValue dim objType 'as string
' change the name of the Tag value to be evaluated set objTypeTV = element.TaggedValues.GetByName("OT_ID")
if not objTypeTV is nothing then
objType = objTypeTV.Value

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC TM Forum Normal Scripts.Utility Scripts
sub startMigration
dim packageGUID 'as String dim package as EA.Package
packageGUID = "{E14D56DB-76A1-4146-B131-45ACEFA4C605}" 'packageGUID = "{B82523FE-2B54-4814-B8E9-A50136B760E8}"
set package = Repository.GetPackageByGuid( packageGUID)
migratePackage package
Session.Output "Finished!"
end sub
sub migratePackage( package)
dim element as EA.Element dim childPackage as EA.Package
Session.Output "Migrating package '" & package.Name & "'..."
if Right( package.Name, 3) = "ABE" then ' setLifecycleStatus package.Element, "TMF_ArchiMate3::TMF_SID_ABE" mergeDuplicateTaggedValues package.Element end if
for each element in package.Elements migrateElement element next
for each childPackage in package.Packages migratePackage childPackage next
end sub
sub mergeDuplicateTaggedValues( element)
dim value 'as String dim taggedValue as EA.TaggedValue dim tvCount 'as Integer dim tvIndex 'as Integer
value = ""
tvCount = element.TaggedValues.Count
for tvIndex = tvCount - 1 to 0 step -1
set taggedValue = element.TaggedValues.GetAt(tvIndex)
if taggedValue.Name = "TMFStatus" then
if taggedValue.Value <> "" then value = taggedValue.Value end if element.TaggedValues.Delete( tvIndex) end if next element.TaggedValues.Refresh
'element.Update
setElementTaggedValueValue element, "SID Lifecycle Status", value
'element.Update
end sub
sub setLifecycleStatus( element, value)
dim stereotype 'as String
stereotype = element.Stereotype
element.StereotypeEx = value element.Update element.TaggedValues.Refresh
setElementTaggedValueValue element, "TMFStatus", stereotype
element.Update
end sub
sub migrateElement( element)
dim childElement as EA.Element
Session.Output "- Migrating element '" & element.Name & "' Type: " & element.Type & "..."
' select case element.Type ' case "Class" ' setLifecycleStatus element, "TMF::TMF_BusinessEntity" ' case "DataType" ' setLifecycleStatus element, "TMF::TMF_SID_DataType" ' case "Enumeration" ' setLifecycleStatus element, "TMF::TMF_SID_Enumeration" ' end select
mergeDuplicateTaggedValues element
for each childElement in element.Elements migrateElement childElement next
end sub
startMigration

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript
' Script Name: CreateComponentFunctionfromDiagram.vbs ' ODA -Create APi from Component ' Work In progress. This script aims to generate a new APi from a component specification. ' The component needs to be connected to TMF Functions that will be transformed into operations of the API. ' Potentially, if a function would be related to a BusienssEntity, that would result into the input/output parameter of the operation. WIP
' Dim componentElementCount, componentControllerClassCreated 'Used to check if there are any use case element are available and throw an error when no use case element is present. componentElementCount = 0 componentControllerClassCreated = 0 dim CompStereo dim APIStereo CompStereo = "ODA Component" APIStereo = "TMF_API"
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
' Handling Code: Uncomment any types you wish this script to support ' NOTE: You can toggle comments on multiple lines that are currently ' selected with [CTRL]+[SHIFT]+[C]. select case treeSelectedType
case otPackage dim basePackageElement as EA.Element dim packagesubElement as EA.Element dim packageElementIndex, packageElementCount set basePackageElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() Session.Output( "ok, its a package") packageElementCount = basePackageElement.Elements.Count - 1
set basePackageElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
for packageElementIndex = 0 to packageElementCount set packagesubElement = basePackageElement.Elements.GetAt(packageElementIndex) checkComponentElement(packagesubElement) next 'packageElementIndex
case otElement 'The root component element dim componentElement as EA.Element
'The controller class created for the component element. dim controllerClass as EA.Element
'The name for the controller class. This will be use case name + Controller. All the spaces are removed. dim className
'Temporary variable and not used. dim retVal
'Getting the use case element. set componentElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
checkComponentElement(componentElement)
end select
if componentElementCount > 0 then Session.Prompt "Function created for " & componentControllerClassCreated & " out of " & componentElementCount & " Components.", promptOK else Session.Prompt "Function can ONLY be created for elements of type" & CompStereo, promptOK end if
end sub
Function checkComponentElement(componentElement) 'The controller class created for the component element. dim controllerClass as EA.Element
'The name for the controller class. This will be use case name + Controller. All the spaces are removed. dim className
'Temporary value dim retVal 'The elements should be dFeature. When any other element is selected it will throw an error message to user. Session.Output( "component stereotype is " + componentElement.Stereotype)
if (componentElement.Stereotype = CompStereo) then 'When the Use Case already exist for feature. Throw an error. Session.Output( "ok its a component") if(checkComponentControllerClass(componentElement)) = 1 then Session.Prompt "API already exist for component " + componentElement.Name, promptOK 'When the controller class is NOT available, then create the class. else className = componentElement.Name + "_API" set controllerClass = componentElement.Elements.AddNew(className, APIStereo) controllerClass.stereotype = APIStereo controllerClass.Notes = componentElement.Notes CreateConnector componentElement, controllerClass controllerClass.Update 'Call the add Methods method which will add all the activity under the component as methods to the Controller class. retVal = addMethods(componentElement, controllerClass) componentControllerClassCreated = componentControllerClassCreated + 1 end if componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 'else ' Session.Prompt "Controllers can ONLY be created for elements of type TMF_ODAComponents (2).", promptOK end if end function
'Function to check if the component element if it has an controller element with name component name + Controller Function checkcomponentControllerClass(componentElement) dim elementCount, elementIndex dim controllerClassElement as EA.Element dim className
elementCount = componentElement.Elements.Count if elementCount > 0 then for elementIndex = 0 to elementCount className = componentElement.Name + "_API" set controllerClassElement = componentElement.Elements.GetAt(elementIndex) if (controllerClassElement.stereotype = APIStereo) and (controllerClassElement.Name = className) then checkcomponentControllerClass = 1 Exit For end if next 'elementCount else checkcomponentControllerClass = 0 end if end Function
'Function to add the activities under component to controller as methods. Function addMethods(componentElement, controllerClass)
end Function
Function CreateConnector( componentElement, controllerClass) ' create a connector between the feature and the use case
dim connMetaclass dim source as EA.Element dim target as EA.Element dim con as EA.Connector
connMetaclass = "Dependency" set source = Repository.GetElementByID( componentElement.ElementId) set target = Repository.GetElementByID( controllerClass.ElementId)
set con = target.Connectors.AddNew (connMetaclass, connMetaclass ) con.Stereotype="TMF::TMF_DependentAPI" con.SupplierID = source.ElementID con.Update source.Connectors.Refresh target.Connectors.Refresh
end Function
OnProjectBrowserScript

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript
' Script Name: CreateUsecaseUserStoryfromDiagram.vbs ' Version : 4.1 ' Author: Giu ' Purpose: This method creates a Implementation Independent Component (IIC) from a package, and connect the new ISC with the using a Realization. ' in the project browser, right click on a package containing Use Cases, ' select "Create User Story from Use Case" ' Move the created user stories in the proper package ' Date: 15-Oct-2022 ' Project Browser Script main function ' Dim usecaseElementCount, usecaseControllerClassCreated 'Used to check if there are any use case element are available and throw an error when no use case element is present. usecaseElementCount = 0 usecaseControllerClassCreated = 0
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
' Handling Code: Uncomment any types you wish this script to support ' NOTE: You can toggle comments on multiple lines that are currently ' selected with [CTRL]+[SHIFT]+[C]. select case treeSelectedType
case otPackage dim basePackageElement as EA.Element dim packagesubElement as EA.Element dim packageElementIndex, packageElementCount set basePackageElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
packageElementCount = basePackageElement.Elements.Count - 1
set basePackageElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
for packageElementIndex = 0 to packageElementCount set packagesubElement = basePackageElement.Elements.GetAt(packageElementIndex) checkUsecaseElement(packagesubElement) next 'packageElementIndex
case otElement 'The root usecase element dim usecaseElement as EA.Element
'The ISC class created for the ISC element. dim controllerClass as EA.Element
'The name for the controller class. This will be use case name + Controller. All the spaces are removed. dim className
'Temporary variable and not used. dim retVal
'Getting the use case element. set usecaseElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
checkUsecaseElement(usecaseElement)
end select
if usecaseElementCount > 0 then Session.Prompt "IIC created for " & usecaseControllerClassCreated & " out of " & usecaseElementCount & " ISC.", promptOK else Session.Prompt "IIC can ONLY be created for elements of type ISC .", promptOK end if
end sub
Function checkUsecaseElement(usecaseElement) 'The controller class created for the usecase element. dim controllerClass as EA.Element
'The name for the controller class. This will be use case name + Controller. All the spaces are removed. dim className
'Temporary value dim retVal 'The elements should be dFeature. When any other element is selected it will throw an error message to user. if (usecaseElement.Stereotype = "TMF_ISC") then 'When the Use Case already exist for feature. Throw an error. if(checkUseCaseControllerClass(usecaseElement)) = 1 then Session.Prompt "TMF_IIC already exist for ISC " + usecaseElement.Name, promptOK 'When the controller class is NOT available, then create the class. else className = usecaseElement.Name + "_IIC" className = Replace(className, " ", " ") set controllerClass = usecaseElement.Elements.AddNew(className, "TMF_IIC") controllerClass.stereotype = "TMF_IIC" controllerClass.Notes = usecaseElement.Notes CreateConnector usecaseElement, controllerClass controllerClass.Update 'Call the add Methods method which will add all the activity under the usecase as methods to the Controller class. retVal = addMethods(usecaseElement, controllerClass) usecaseControllerClassCreated = usecaseControllerClassCreated + 1 end if usecaseElementCount = usecaseElementCount + 1 'else ' Session.Prompt "Controllers can ONLY be created for elements of type dBusinessUseCase or dBusinessUseCaseCore.", promptOK end if end function
'Function to check if the ISC element if it has an IIC element with same name already Function checkUseCaseControllerClass(usecaseElement) dim elementCount, elementIndex dim controllerClassElement as EA.Element dim className
elementCount = usecaseElement.Elements.Count if elementCount > 0 then for elementIndex = 0 to elementCount className = usecaseElement.Name + "_IIC" set controllerClassElement = usecaseElement.Elements.GetAt(elementIndex) if (controllerClassElement.stereotype = "TMF_IIC") and (controllerClassElement.Name = className) then checkUseCaseControllerClass = 1 Exit For end if next 'elementCount else checkUseCaseControllerClass = 0 end if end Function
'Function to add the activities under usecase to controller as methods. Function addMethods(usecaseElement, controllerClass)
end Function
Function CreateConnector( usecaseElement, controllerClass) ' create a connector between the feature and the use case
dim connMetaclass dim source as EA.Element dim target as EA.Element dim con as EA.Connector
connMetaclass = "Realization" set target= Repository.GetElementByID( usecaseElement.ElementId) set source = Repository.GetElementByID( controllerClass.ElementId)
set con = target.Connectors.AddNew (connMetaclass, connMetaclass ) con.Stereotype="TMF::TMF_RealizesComponent" con.SupplierID = source.ElementID con.Update source.Connectors.Refresh target.Connectors.Refresh
end Function
OnProjectBrowserScript

' Script Name: * Author: Giu Platania ' Purpose: generate a ProtoBuff File. this is used in the schema composer ' Date: 8/28/2020 ' !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Wrappers.Include
Sub main() Dim schema As EA.SchemaComposer Dim xmlType As EA.SchemaType
Dim xmlTypeEnum As EA.SchemaTypeEnum Dim xmlProp As EA.SchemaProperty Dim xmlPropEnum As EA.SchemaPropEnum Dim xmlChoice As EA.SchemaType Dim xmlChoiceEnum As EA.SchemaTypeEnum ' COnfiguration Header
Dim thesyntax 'As String thesyntax = "syntax = ""proto3"";" Dim optionOptimizeFor 'As String optionOptimizeFor = "option optimize_for = LITE_RUNTIME;" Dim protobufPackage '' As String protobufPackage = "package atakmap.commoncommo.protobuf.v3;"
Session.Output syntax Session.Output optionOptimizeFor Session.Output protobufPackage ' Get SchemaComposer Set schema = Repository.SchemaComposer ' Get Schema Types Enumerator Set xmlTypeEnum = schema.SchemaTypes ' Get total number of types in schema Dim count ''As Integer count = xmlTypeEnum.GetCount() ' Enumerate Types Dim UMLProtoDict ''As Object Set UMLProtoDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") UMLProtoDict.Add "boolean", "bool" UMLProtoDict.Add "int", "sint32" UMLProtoDict.Add "string", "string" UMLProtoDict.Add "float", "float" UMLProtoDict.Add "long", "sint64" UMLProtoDict.Add "byte", "bytes" UMLProtoDict.Add "double", "double" Set xmlType = xmlTypeEnum.GetFirst() While Not (xmlType Is Nothing) ' Print Class note 'Session.Output( "// " + xmlType. + " {"); Session.Output "Message " & xmlType.TypeName & " {" Set xmlPropEnum = xmlType.Properties Dim number ''As Integer number = 0 If Not (xmlPropEnum Is Nothing) Then Set xmlProp = xmlPropEnum.GetFirst()
While Not (xmlProp Is Nothing) number = number + 1 Dim sPropDesc '' As String sPropDesc = xmlProp.Name sPropDesc = sPropDesc & " =" & number
' checks if attribute is optional
If xmlProp.IsPrimitive() Then
sPropDesc = UMLProtoDict.Item(xmlProp.PrimitiveType) & " " & sPropDesc Else 'seems to be triggered on attrib type being a uml object instance sPropDesc = xmlProp.TypeName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + xmlProp.TypeName.substring(1) + " " + sPropDesc; End If
If xmlProp.Cardinality = "0..1" Then sPropDesc = "optional " & sPropDesc End If
If xmlProp.InitialValue.length>0 Then sPropDesc = sPropDesc & " [default = " & xmlProp.InitialValue & "]" End If
If xmlProp.IsByReference() Then sPropDesc = sPropDesc & " (by reference) " End If If xmlProp.IsInline() Then sPropDesc = sPropDesc & " (inline) " End If
Dim comment ''As String comment = xmlProp.Annotation.replace(/(\r\n|\n|\r)/gm, "") Session.Output " " & sPropDesc & "; // " & comment Set xmlChoiceEnum = xmlProp.Choices If xmlChoiceEnum.GetCount()>0 Then
Set xmlChoice = xmlChoiceEnum.GetFirst() Session.Output " ENUM: " While Not (xmlChoice Is Nothing)
Session.Output " " & xmlChoice.TypeName Set xmlChoice = xmlChoiceEnum.GetNext() Wend End If Set xmlProp = xmlPropEnum.GetNext() Wend End If Set xmlType = xmlTypeEnum.GetNext() ' close tag Session.Output "}" Wend 'TODO: change from VB to JS set scriptFile = New TextFile scriptfile.Contents = sqlGetString ''save the script scriptFile.FullPath = Path & SourceStereotype& "_" & connectortype & "_" & TargetStereotype & ".sql" scriptFile.Save

function getDiagramLevelList

set levelList = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

level1.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level1.objectStyle.fontSize = 12 level1.objectStyle.fontBold = "0" ' true level1.objectStyle.fontColor = colorBlack

level2.objectstyle.fillColor = colorWhite level2.objectstyle.fontName = "Arial" level2.objectstyle.fontSize = 9

dim relationProfileAggFunc set relationProfileAggFunc = new RelationProfile relationProfileAggFunc.nestingType = "Nested"

levellist.add 2, level2

' end level 3 function element profile
' begin level 3 Aggregated Function element profile dim Level3AggFuncElementProfile set Level3AggFuncElementProfile = new ElementProfile Level3AggFuncElementProfile.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function"

' end level 3 Aggregated Function element profile
level3.elementProfiles.Add "Function", Level3FuncElementProfile level3.elementProfiles.Add "AggFunction", Level3AggFuncElementProfile
''levellist.add 3, level3 ' end level 3 set getDiagramLevelList = levelList
end function
