Throw an error. if(checkUseCaseControllerClass(usecaseElement)) = 1 then Session.Prompt "TMF_IIC already exist for ISC " + usecaseElement.Name, promptOK 'When the controller class is NOT available, then create the class. else className = usecaseElement.Name + "_IIC" className = Replace(className, " ", " ") set controllerClass = usecaseElement.Elements.AddNew(className, "TMF_IIC") controllerClass.stereotype = "TMF_IIC" controllerClass.Notes = usecaseElement.Notes CreateConnector usecaseElement, controllerClass controllerClass.Update 'Call the add Methods method which will add all the activity under the usecase as methods to the Controller class. retVal = addMethods(usecaseElement, controllerClass) usecaseControllerClassCreated = usecaseControllerClassCreated + 1 end if usecaseElementCount = usecaseElementCount + 1 'else ' Session.Prompt "Controllers can ONLY be created for elements of type dBusinessUseCase or dBusinessUseCaseCore.", promptOK end if end function
'Function to check if the ISC element if it has an IIC element with same name already Function checkUseCaseControllerClass(usecaseElement) dim elementCount, elementIndex dim controllerClassElement as EA.Element dim className
elementCount = usecaseElement.Elements.Count if elementCount > 0 then for elementIndex = 0 to elementCount className = usecaseElement.Name + "_IIC" set controllerClassElement = usecaseElement.Elements.GetAt(elementIndex) if (controllerClassElement.stereotype = "TMF_IIC") and (controllerClassElement.Name = className) then checkUseCaseControllerClass = 1 Exit For end if next 'elementCount else checkUseCaseControllerClass = 0 end if end Function
'Function to add the activities under usecase to controller as methods. Function addMethods(usecaseElement, controllerClass)
end Function
OnProjectBrowserScript

' Script Name: ' Author: ' Purpose: Print a table with all the messages between a ISC and API for doc generators ' Date:
Function GenerateMessages(elementGuid, diagramType) dim IIC 'set IIC = Repository.GetElementByGuid(elementGuid) set IIC = Repository.GetElementByID(elementGuid) 'Dim ISC 'Set ISC = GetISCFromIIC(IIC)
Dim diagrams Set diagrams = IIC.Diagrams
Dim xmlOutput xmlOutput = "<EADATA><Dataset_0><Data>"
Dim o For o = 0 To diagrams.Count - 1 Dim diagram as EA.Diagram Set diagram = diagrams.GetAt(o) If diagram.MetaType = diagramType Then xmlOutput = xmlOutput & GetMessageNamesFromDiagram(diagram) End If Next xmlOutput = xmlOutput & "</Data></Dataset_0></EADATA>" Session.Output xmlOutput GenerateMessages = xmlOutput End Function
Function GetMessageNamesFromDiagram(diagram) Dim xmlContent xmlContent = ""
Dim l For l = 0 To diagram.DiagramLinks.Count - 1 Dim link Set link = diagram.DiagramLinks.GetAt(l)
Dim connector as EA.Connector Set connector = Repository.GetConnectorByID(link.ConnectorID)
If connector.Type = "Sequence" Then ' xmlContent = xmlContent & "<Row"&_ ' " OperationName = """ & ConvertToCamelCase(connector.Name) & """" &_ ' " ResourceName = """ & GetReturnVal(connector.TransitionGuard) & """" &_ ' " APIName = """ & Repository.GetElementByID(connector.SupplierID).Name & """" &_ ' "></Row>" xmlContent = xmlContent & "<Row>"&_ "<OperationName>" & ConvertToCamelCase(connector.Name) & "</OperationName>" &_ "<APIName>" & Repository.GetElementByID(connector.SupplierID).Name & "</APIName>" &_ "</Row>" End If Next
GetMessageNamesFromDiagram = xmlContent End Function
Function GetISCFromIIC(IIC) Dim n For n = 0 To IIC.Elements.Count - 1 Dim child Set child = IIC.Elements.GetAt(n)
If child.Stereotype = "TMF_ISC" Then Set GetISCFromIIC = child Exit Function End If Next Set GetISCFromIIC = Nothing End Function
Function GetReturnVal(inputString) Dim result Dim parts parts = Split(Split(inputString, ";")(0), "=") if UBound(parts) + 1 >1 then if parts(0) = "retval" then GetReturnVal = parts(1) Else GetReturnVal = "" End if Else GetReturnVal = "" END IF End Function
Function ConvertToCamelCase(inputString) Dim parts Dim i Dim result
' Split the input string by "(" to get the first part (the camel case name). parts = Split(inputString, "(") if UBound(parts) + 1 >0 then ConvertToCamelCase = parts(0) Else ConvertToCamelCase = "" END IF
End Function
Function Main(elementGuid) Session.Output "Processing Some Object id" dim returnVal returnVal = GenerateMessages(elementGuid, "Component::Components - Events Published") Main = returnVal END Function

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Utils.Model Management Utilities !INC Utils.Util ' ' Script Name: Util - move element to correct package ' Author: Giu ' Purpose: this script supports models that are aggregated by groups elements and on the same time , listed in packages with the same name of the grouping element. ' The script will move the element under a package with the same name of the grouping element. ' Date: 2023 12 06 '
sub OnProjectBrowserScript() ' configure this GroupingStereotypeName = "TMF_MetricGroup" GroupingMetaTypeName = "Metric Group" StereotypeName = "TMF_Metric" MetaTypeName = "Metric" ' end of config
Dim metricElement As EA.Element Dim metricGroupElement As EA.Element dim treeSelectedType dim Masterpackage as EA.Package dim pkg as EA.Package dim targetPackage as EA.Package dim GroupingStereotypeName, StereotypeName dim GroupingMetaTypeName, MetaTypeName dim connector as EA.Connector dim Query 'as string Dim result Dim resultArray Dim sqlGetPackage
treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() select case treeSelectedType case otPackage set Masterpackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' Iterate through all elements with the "TMF_metric" stereotype 'For Each metricElement In Repository.Models.GetElementsByQuery("SELECT * FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype='TMF_metric'") for each metricElement in Masterpackage.Elements ' find those of a specific metatype and set the RefGUID of their associated package if metricElement.MetaType = MetaTypeName then session.output("processing: " & metricElement.name) ' Find the connected "TMF_MetricGroup" element via a "TMF_MetricGroupMetric" relationship
Set metricGroupElement = Nothing For Each connector In metricElement.Connectors If connector.Stereotype = "TMF_MetricGroupMetric" Then Set metricGroupElement = Repository.GetElementByID(connector.SupplierID) Exit For End If Next
' Check if a valid "TMF_MetricGroup" element was found If Not metricGroupElement Is Nothing Then ' Use a SQL query to find the target package with the same name
sqlGetPackage = "SELECT o.Package_ID FROM t_package as o WHERE o.Name = '" & metricGroupElement.Name & "'" session.output("executing query: " & sqlGetPackage) Query = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlGetPackage) session.output("result of query: " & Query) resultArray = convertQueryResultToArray(Query) If Not IsEmpty(resultArray) Then ' Get the first package ID from the result for each result in resultArray on error resume next session.output("Get the corresponding package based on package ID: " & result) set targetPackage = Repository.GetPackageByID(result) ' Move the "TMF_metric" element to the found package If Not targetPackage Is Nothing Then session.output("found package: " & targetPackage.name) metricElement.PackageID = targetPackage.PackageID metricElement.Update End If next ' for each result in resultArray End If ' is not empty End If 'Not metricGroupElement Is Nothing Then end if ' metricElement.MetaType = MetaTypeName Next ' for each metricElement session.output("done processing " & MetaTypeName ) case else Session.Prompt "This script is looking for elements " = MetaTypeName + "in a package.", promptOK end select end sub

Option Explicit
' Create an Excel file that lists all TMF API and their operations in a package
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Wrappers.Include
Sub OnProjectBrowserScript() Dim treeSelectedType Dim package As EA.Package
treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
Select Case treeSelectedType Case otPackage Set package = Repository.GetTreeSelectedPackage() If Not package Is Nothing Then ' Create Excel file and write header Dim excelOutput Set excelOutput = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
' Create a new workbook Dim workbook Set workbook = excelOutput.Workbooks.Add
' Create a new worksheet Dim worksheet Set worksheet = workbook.Worksheets(1) worksheet.Name = package.Name
' Write header worksheet.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Element Name" worksheet.Cells(1, 2).Value = "Element Type" worksheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "Operation" worksheet.Cells(1, 4).Value = "Parameters" worksheet.Cells(1, 5).Value = "ReturnType"
' Start writing elements from the second row Dim currentRow currentRow = 2
' Collect elements and their operations in the package CollectElementsInPackage package, worksheet, currentRow
workbook.Saveas getUserSelectedFileName ' WTF!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!?????????????????? excelOutput.Visible = True excelOutput.Quit Session.Output " Finished Export API Tree '"
End If
Case Else Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK End Select End Sub
Sub CollectElementsInPackage(package, worksheet, currentRow) Dim element As EA.Element Dim operation as EA.Method
' Loop through each element in the package For Each element In package.Elements If element.Stereotype = "TMF_API" then ' Write the current element's information to the worksheet WriteElementToWorksheet element, worksheet, currentRow
' Increment the current row for the next element currentRow = currentRow + 1
' Collect operations of the current element For Each operation In element.Methods WriteOperationToWorksheet operation, worksheet, currentRow if operation.Parameters.Count > 0 then 'WriteParameterToWorksheet operation, worksheet, currentRow worksheet.Cells(currentRow, 4).Value = GetParameterNames(operation) end if currentRow = currentRow + 1 Next End If Next End Sub
Sub WriteElementToWorksheet(element, worksheet, currentRow) ' Write element information to the worksheet worksheet.Cells(currentRow, 1).Value = element.Name worksheet.Cells(currentRow, 2).Value = element.Stereotype End Sub
Sub WriteOperationToWorksheet(operation, worksheet, currentRow) ' Write operation information to the worksheet worksheet.Cells(currentRow, 3).Value = operation.Name worksheet.Cells(currentRow, 5).Value = operation.ReturnType
End Sub
sub WriteParameterToWorksheet (operation, worksheet, currentRow) Dim i dim j i = operation.Parameters.Count - 1 dim Parameter as EA.Parameter For j = 0 to i Set Parameter = operation.Parameters.GetAt(j) worksheet.Cells(currentRow, 4).Value = Parameter.Type currentRow = currentRow + 1 next End Sub
Function getUserSelectedFileName() Dim selectedFileName Dim project Set project = Repository.GetProjectInterface() selectedFileName = project.GetFileNameDialog("", "Excel Files|*.xls;*.xlsx;*.xlsm", 1, 2, "", 1) ' Save as with overwrite prompt: OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT getUserSelectedFileName = selectedFileName End Function
OnProjectBrowserScript()

' Script utilities to update label settings for all connectors on a diagram. '
const SECTION_DELIMITER = "$" const GEOMETRY_DELIMITER = ";" const LABEL_DELIMITER = ":" const ASSIGNMENT = "="
sub HideCurrentDiagramConnectorLabels( labelIDList)
dim theDiagram as EA.Diagram
set theDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram
theDiagram.Update
HideDiagramConnectorLabels theDiagram, labelIDList
theDiagram.Update
end sub
sub HideDiagramConnectorLabels( theDiagram, labelIDList)
dim diagramLink as EA.DiagramLink dim labelIDArray 'as String() dim labelID 'as String
labelIDArray = Split(labelIDList, GEOMETRY_DELIMITER)
for each diagramLink in theDiagram.DiagramLinks
for each labelID in labelIDArray HideDiagramLinkLabel diagramLink, labelID next
diagramLink.Update
next
Repository.ReloadDiagram theDiagram.DiagramID
end sub
sub HideDiagramLinkLabel( diagramLink, labelID)
dim geometrySectionList 'as String dim geometrySectionArray 'as String() dim labelStyleList 'as String dim labelStyleArray 'as String() dim labelStyleIndex 'as Integer dim labelStyle 'as String dim styleFound 'as Boolean
geometrySectionList = diagramLink.Geometry
geometrySectionArray = Split( geometrySectionList, SECTION_DELIMITER)
labelStyleList = geometrySectionArray(1)
labelStyleArray = Split(labelStyleList, GEOMETRY_DELIMITER)
labelStyleIndex = 0 styleFound = false
for each labelStyle in labelStyleArray
if InStr( labelStyle, labelID & ASSIGNMENT) then
labelStyle = labelID & ASSIGNMENT & "HDN=1"
labelStyleArray( labelStyleIndex) = labelStyle
styleFound = true
exit for
end if
labelStyleIndex = labelStyleIndex + 1
next
labelStyleList = Join( labelStyleArray, GEOMETRY_DELIMITER)
if not( styleFound) then labelStyleList = labelStyleList & labelID & ASSIGNMENT & "HDN=1" & GEOMETRY_DELIMITER end if
geometrySectionArray(1) = labelStyleList
geometrySectionList = Join( geometrySectionArray, SECTION_DELIMITER)
diagramLink.Geometry = geometrySectionList
end sub
sub test
dim theDiagram as EA.Diagram
set theDiagram = Repository.GetDiagramByID( 129)
HideDiagramConnectorLabels theDiagram, "LLT;LRT"
end sub
'test

Column.name: Script
Column.value:
option explicit
' creates a diagram inside each ABE located in a package
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Create Nested Hierarchy Diagram !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Color Constants
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
dim treeSelectedType dim package as EA.Package dim levelList ' as Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim element as EA.Element
treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
select case treeSelectedType
case otPackage
set package = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() set levelList = getDiagramLevelList
for each element in package.Elements if element.MetaType = "ABE" then createNestedHierarchyDiagram element, levelList, "ABE", false end if next
case else
Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK
end select
end sub
OnProjectBrowserScript
sub Test(packageGUID)
dim package As EA.Package dim levelList ' as Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim element as EA.Element
set package = Repository.GetPackageByGuid(packageGUID)
set levelList = getDiagramLevelList
for each element in package.Elements if element.MetaType = "ABE" then createNestedHierarchyDiagram element, levelList, "Custom", false end if next
end sub
function getDiagramLevelList
dim levelList ' as Scripting.Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim level1 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level2 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level3 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level4 ' as HierarchyLevel
set levelList = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
' *** FIRST LEVEL ***
set level1 = New HierarchyLevel
level1.numObjects = 3 level1.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level1.elementMetatype = "Vertical" level1.objectHeight = 100 level1.objectWidth = 200 level1.horizOffset = 10 level1.horizSpace = 20 level1.vertOffset = 10 level1.vertSpace = 20
level1.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level1.objectStyle.fontSize = 12 level1.objectStyle.fontBold = "1" ' true
levelList.Add 1, level1
set level2 = new hierarchylevel
level2.numobjects = 9 level2.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level2.flowdirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level2.elementMetatype = "ABE" level2.objectHeight = 60 level2.objectWidth = 150 level2.horizOffset = 10 level2.horizSpace = 10 level2.vertOffset = 50 level2.vertSpace = 10
level2.objectstyle.fillcolor = colorWhite level2.objectstyle.fontname = "ABE" level2.objectstyle.fontsize = 9
levellist.add 2, level2
set getDiagramLevelList = levelList
end function

Column.name: Script
Column.value:
option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript
' Script Name: ' Author: DBC ' Purpose: ' Script to set Author property for package and its elements and diagrams. ' Date: 2022 - 04 -15
' Project Browser Script main function ' sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
' Handling Code: Uncomment any types you wish this script to support ' NOTE: You can toggle comments on multiple lines that are currently ' selected with [CTRL]+[SHIFT]+[C]. select case treeSelectedType
' case otElement ' ' Code for when an element is selected ' dim theElement as EA.Element ' set theElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' case otPackage ' ' Code for when a package is selected dim thePackage as EA.Package set thePackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
setpackageElementsAuthor thePackage.PackageGUID, "TMF"
' case otDiagram ' ' Code for when a diagram is selected ' dim theDiagram as EA.Diagram ' set theDiagram = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' ' case otAttribute ' ' Code for when an attribute is selected ' dim theAttribute as EA.Attribute ' set theAttribute = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' ' case otMethod ' ' Code for when a method is selected ' dim theMethod as EA.Method ' set theMethod = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
case else ' Error message Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK
end select
end sub
sub setpackageElementsAuthor( packageGUID, author)
dim package as EA.Package dim element as EA.Element dim subElement as EA.Element dim diagram as EA.Diagram
set package = Repository.GetPackageByGuid( packageGUID)
Session.Output "Updating Author property for '" & package.Name & "' package..."
package.Element.Author = author package.Element.Update
for each element in package.Elements
Session.Output "- Element '" & element.Name & "' " & element.ObjectType
element.Author = author element.Update for each subElement in element.Elements Session.Output "- Element '" & subElement.Name & "' " & subElement.ObjectType subElement.Author = author subElement.Update next next
for each diagram in package.Diagrams
Session.Output "- Diagram '" & diagram.Name & "'"
diagram.Author = author diagram.Update
next Session.Output "done'" end sub
OnProjectBrowserScript

option explicit ' ' applied to a package, will create diagram containing elements of level 2,3 and 4 for each element of the package !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Create Nested Hierarchy Diagram !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Color Constants
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
dim treeSelectedType dim package as EA.Package dim levelList ' as Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim element as EA.Element
treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() Session.Output "starting" select case treeSelectedType case otPackage Session.Output "package selected" set package = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() set levelList = getDiagramLevelList for each element in package.Elements Session.Output "element type " + element.MetaType + " found!" if element.MetaType = "eTOM Process" then createNestedHierarchyDiagram element, levelList, "custom", false end if next
case otElement Session.Output "element selected" dim theElement as EA.Element set theElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() set levelList = getDiagramLevelList Session.Output "element " + theElement.Name + " found!" if theElement.MetaType = "eTOM Process" then Session.Output "Element "+ theElement.Name + " found" createNestedHierarchyDiagram theElement, levelList, "custom", false end if
case else Session.Prompt "This script support items of type package.", promptOK end select Session.Output "done" end sub

function getDiagramLevelList
dim levelList ' as Scripting.Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim level1 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level2 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level3 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level4 ' as HierarchyLevel
set levelList = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
' *** FIRST LEVEL ***
set level1 = New HierarchyLevel
level1.numObjects = 1 level1.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level1.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function;Function" level1.objectHeight = 120 level1.objectWidth = 400 level1.horizOffset = 10 level1.horizSpace = 10 level1.vertOffset = 10 level1.vertSpace = 10
level1.objectStyle.fontName = "Calibri" level1.objectStyle.fontSize = 12 level1.objectStyle.fontBold = "0" ' true level1.objectStyle.fontColor = colorBlack
level1.elementProfiles.Add "Function", elementProfileFunc
levelList.Add 1, level1
set level2 = new hierarchylevel
level2.numobjects = 3 level2.flowdirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level2.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function;Function" level2.objectHeight = 70 level2.objectWidth = 300 level2.horizOffset = 25 level2.horizSpace = 10 level2.vertOffset = 50 level2.vertSpace = 20
level2.objectstyle.fillColor = colorWhite level2.objectstyle.fontName = "Calibri" level2.objectstyle.fontSize = 9
dim elementProfileFunc set elementProfileFunc = new ElementProfile
dim relationProfileFunc set relationProfileFunc = new RelationProfile relationProfileFunc.nestingType = "Nested"
elementProfileFunc.relationProfiles.Add "NestedFunc", relationProfileFunc elementProfileFunc.elementMetatype = "Function"
dim relationProfileAggFunc set relationProfileAggFunc = new RelationProfile relationProfileAggFunc.nestingType = "Nested"
dim elementProfileAggFunc set elementProfileAggFunc = new ElementProfile elementProfileAggFunc.relationProfiles.Add "NestedAggFunc", relationProfileAggFunc elementProfileAggFunc.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function"
level2.elementProfiles.Add "Function", elementProfileFunc level2.elementProfiles.Add "AggFunction", elementProfileAggFunc
levellist.add 2, level2
' begin level 3 definition set level3 = new hierarchylevel
level3.numobjects = 3 level3.flowdirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level3.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function;Function" level3.objectHeight = 70 level3.objectWidth = 300 level3.horizOffset = 25 level3.horizSpace = 10 level3.vertOffset = 50 level3.vertSpace = 20
level3.objectstyle.fillColor = colorWhite level3.objectstyle.fontName = "Calibri" level3.objectstyle.fontSize = 9
' begin level 3 function element profile dim Level3FuncElementProfile set Level3FuncElementProfile = new ElementProfile Level3FuncElementProfile.elementMetatype = "Function"
' begin level 3 function element profile, aggregation relation profile dim Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr set Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr = new RelationProfile Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr.nestingType = "Related" Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr.relationType = "Aggregation" Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr.relationStereotype = "TMF_AFAggregatesFunction" Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr.relatedStereotype = "TMF_AF" Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr.relatedType = "Class" Level3FuncElementProfile.relationProfiles.Add "AggregatedRel", Level3FuncRelationProfileAggr ' end level 3 function element profile, aggregation relation profile
' end level 3 function element profile
' begin level 3 Aggregated Function element profile dim Level3AggFuncElementProfile set Level3AggFuncElementProfile = new ElementProfile Level3AggFuncElementProfile.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function"
' begin level 3 aggregated function element profile, nested profile dim Level3NestRelationProfile set Level3NestRelationProfile = new RelationProfile Level3NestRelationProfile.nestingType = "Nested" Level3AggFuncElementProfile.relationProfiles.Add "Nested", Level3NestRelationProfile ' end level 3 aggregated function element profile, nested profile
' end level 3 Aggregated Function element profile
level3.elementProfiles.Add "Function", Level3FuncElementProfile level3.elementProfiles.Add "AggFunction", Level3AggFuncElementProfile
levellist.add 3, level3 ' end level 3 set getDiagramLevelList = levelList
end function

option explicit !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript '
' ' Script Name: ' Author: ' Purpose: Create a diagram with all the children (owned) elements and the parent (if Any). Diagram layout is WIP. ' Date:
' Project Browser Script main function
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim theElement as EA.Element dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() Session.Output "Starting Diagram" ' Handling Code: Uncomment any types you wish this script to support ' NOTE: You can toggle comments on multiple lines that are currently ' selected with [CTRL]+[SHIFT]+[C]. select case treeSelectedType
case otElement ' Code for when an element is selected set theElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() Session.Output "OK, Its an element of stereotype " + theElement.Stereotype createDiagram (theElement)
' case otPackage ' ' Code for when a package is selected ' dim thePackage as EA.Package ' set thePackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' createDiagram theElement ' ' case otDiagram ' ' Code for when a diagram is selected ' dim theDiagram as EA.Diagram ' set theDiagram = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' ' case otAttribute ' ' Code for when an attribute is selected ' dim theAttribute as EA.Attribute ' set theAttribute = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() ' ' case otMethod ' ' Code for when a method is selected ' dim theMethod as EA.Method ' set theMethod = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
case else ' Error message Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK
end select end sub
sub createDiagram(theElement) ' Create a new diagram and set its properties Dim newDiagram as EA.Diagram Dim selectedElement as EA.Element Set selectedElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
Set newDiagram = selectedElement.Diagrams.AddNew( selectedElement.Name & "_Diagram", "Logical") newDiagram.Author = "Your Name" newDiagram.Notes = "This diagram shows the element" + selectedElement.Name + " and its children" newDiagram.Version = "1.0" newDiagram.PackageID = selectedElement.PackageID newDiagram.Update() Session.Output "New Diagram created" ' Add the selected element and its parent to the diagram
Dim selectedObject as EA.DiagramObject set selectedObject = newDiagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew ("", "")
selectedObject.ElementID = selectedElement.ElementID selectedObject.Update() newDiagram.Update()
Dim parent as EA.Element
If Not selectedElement.ParentID = 0 Then Set parent = Repository.GetElementByID(selectedElement.ParentID) If Not parent is Nothing Then Set selectedObject = newDiagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew ("", "") selectedObject.ElementID = parent.ElementID selectedObject.Update() Session.Output "Parent Objects"+ selectedObject.name + " added" End If Else Session.Output "No Parent objects found" End If
' Add all child elements to the diagram
Dim child as EA.Element If selectedElement.Elements.Count = 0 Then Session.Output "No Child Objects found" Else For Each child In selectedElement.Elements Set selectedObject = newDiagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew("", "") selectedObject.ElementID = child.ElementID selectedObject.Update() Session.Output "a Child Object was added" next End If ' Refresh the diagram view in the EA interface Repository.ReloadDiagram(newDiagram.DiagramID)
'' layout the diagram layoutDiagram newDiagram.DiagramID ' Save the changes to the project newDiagram.Update()
Session.Prompt "Finished!", promptOK ' End of script end sub
sub layoutDiagram(DiagramGUID) Dim LayoutStyle, Iterations, LayerSpacing, ColumnSpacing, SaveToDiagram Dim Project As EA.Project Dim Repository As EA.Repository
Set Repository = CreateObject("EA.Repository") Set Project = Repository.GetProjectInterface() Session.Output "layout Diagram"
'DiagramGUID = Project.GUIDtoXML(Repository.GetCurrentDiagram().DiagramGUID)
'See ConstLayoutStyles in EAConstants-VBcript 'LayoutStyle = lsDiagramDefault 'LayoutStyle = lsCycleRemoveDFS 'Or lsLayeringOptimalLinkLength Or lsInitializeDFSOut Or lsLayoutDirectionDown LayoutStyle = lsLayoutDirectionDown
Iterations = 4 LayerSpacing = 20 ColumnSpacing = 20 SaveToDiagram = true
dim diagramGUIDXml 'The project interface needs GUID's in XML format, so we need to convert first. diagramGUIDXml = Repository.GetProjectInterface().GUIDtoXML(DiagramGUID) 'Then call the layout operation Session.Output "diagram UID in Xml " + diagramGUIDXml Repository.GetProjectInterface().LayoutDiagramEx diagramGUIDXml, lsDiagramDefault, 4, 20 , 20, false
'Project.LayoutDiagramEx DiagramGUID, LayoutStyle, Iterations, LayerSpacing, ColumnSpacing, SaveToDiagram end sub
OnProjectBrowserScript

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Utils.Model Management Utilities !INC Utils.Util
' ' Script Name: SetPackageRefId ' Author: Giu Platania ' Purpose: This script search for elements of a determine type and the for a package with the exact same name ' the it set the a Tag value with the reference ID of the element in the package ' The script can be configured for different cases by commenting out the specific line of code. ' Date: 2023-05-16 dim StereotypeName, MetaTypeName dim Masterpackage as EA.Package dim subElement as EA.Element ' lev 2 dim subsubElement as EA.Element ' lev 3
''comment and uncomment as required StereotypeName = "TMF_ABE" MetaTypeName = "ABE" ' StereotypeName = "TMF_AF" 'MetaTypeName = "Aggregated Function" 'StereotypeName = "TMF_MetricGroup" ' MetaTypeName = "Metric Group"
' function SetRefGUID(element) Dim package As EA.Package Dim parentPackage as EA.Package
' find the package which should be relatred to the given element set package = getCorrespondingPackage(element.name, StereotypeName) ' if the package exists then set it's RefGUID to add traceability If Not package Is Nothing Then Session.Output "Package found: " & package.Name & " with package ID " & package.PackageID setTaggedValuePackageValue Package, "RefGUID", element.ElementGUID Else ' Package not found Session.Output "ERROR! Package " & element.name & " not found nor created" end if 'GetPackageByName element.name
end function
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
dim treeSelectedType dim element as EA.Element Session.Prompt "This script currently check for " + MetaTypeName, promptOK treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() select case treeSelectedType case otPackage set Masterpackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
' iterate the first level of elements in the package for each element in Masterpackage.Elements ' find those of a specific metatype and set the RefGUID of their associated package if element.MetaType = MetaTypeName then Session.Output "processing " + element.Name SetRefGUID element end if ' now evaluate children for each subElement in element.Elements if subElement.MetaType = MetaTypeName then set Masterpackage = getParentPackage(element.name, StereotypeName) Session.Output "Parent package is" + Masterpackage.Name Session.Output "processing " + subElement.Name SetRefGUID subElement end if ' now evaluate children's children for each subsubElement in subelement.Elements if subsubElement.MetaType = MetaTypeName then set Masterpackage = getParentPackage(subelement.name, StereotypeName) Session.Output "Parent package for "& subsubElement.name & " is" + Masterpackage.Name Session.Output "processing " + subsubElement.Name SetRefGUID subsubElement end if next ' subsubElement next 'subelement next ' element Session.Output "Done setting all REFGUID! " & Masterpackage.Elements.Count case else Session.Prompt "This script is looking for elements " = MetaTypeName + "in a package.", promptOK end select end sub
' get a package with the same name as the element by SQL function getCorrespondingPackage(ElementName, StereotypeName) dim sqlGetElement dim masterElement as EA.Package dim getCorrespondingElement as EA.Package dim parentPackage as EA.Package dim connectorIDs dim connectorID dim result
'initialize to nothing 'set getCorrespondingElement = nothing sqlGetElement = "SELECT p.Package_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS o " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_package as p ON o.name = p.name " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE o.Stereotype = '"& StereotypeName &"' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND o.name='"& ElementName &"' "
' execute query to get all pacakges of name `ElementName` and stereotype `StereotypeName` result = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlGetElement) 'Session.Output "XML query is" & result
' QUESTION: why is the result of the query Connector IDs? connectorIDs = convertQueryResultToArray(result) 'Iterate over connectorIDs array and get the first result for each connectorID in connectorIDs
on error resume next ' Get the corresponding package based on connectorID set getCorrespondingElement = Repository.GetPackageByID(connectorID)
' QUESTION: why do we create a new package here but not on line 29? if err.Number <> 0 or getCorrespondingElement is nothing then Session.Output "Package "& element.name & " not found. creating a new one" on error goto 0 set parentPackage = Masterpackage set getCorrespondingElement = parentPackage.Packages.AddNew(ElementName, "") getCorrespondingElement.Update() err.Clear end if
' Exit the loop after getting the first result exit for next ' Return the corresponding package set getCorrespondingPackage = getCorrespondingElement end function
' Function: getParentPackage ' ' Description: Retrieves the parent package with the specified name and stereotype. ' If not found, it returns the Masterpackage. ' ' Parameters: ' - ElementName: The name of the element to find. ' - StereotypeName: The stereotype of the element to find. ' ' Returns: The parent package if found, or the Masterpackage if not found. ' '----
Function getParentPackage(ElementName, StereotypeName) Dim sqlGetElement Dim newMasterPackage As EA.Package Dim result Dim resultArray DIM Query
' Define the SQL query to find the package sqlGetElement = "SELECT o.Package_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_package AS o " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE o.name='"& ElementName &"' "
' Execute the query to get the package ID Query = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlGetElement) resultArray = convertQueryResultToArray(Query) ' Check if the query returned any results If Not IsEmpty(resultArray) Then ' Get the first package ID from the result for each result in resultArray on error resume next ' Get the corresponding package based on package ID session.output("Get the corresponding package based on package ID: " & result) Set newMasterPackage = Repository.GetPackageByID(result) ' Check if the package exists If Not (newMasterPackage Is Nothing) Then ' Return the corresponding package Set getParentPackage = newMasterPackage session.output("Parent is" = getParentPackage.name) Exit Function End If On Error GoTo 0 next End If ' If the package was not found, return the Masterpackage Set getParentPackage = Masterpackage session.output("failed to retrieve. Parent is" = getParentPackage.name) End Function
' NOT USED ATM ' we look for a package to be the new parent with the name of the element function getParentPackage2(ElementName, StereotypeName) dim sqlGetElement dim masterElement as EA.Package dim getCorrespondingElement as EA.Package dim parentPackage as EA.Package dim connectorIDs dim connectorID dim result
' Initialize to nothing ' Set getCorrespondingElement = nothing sqlGetElement = "SELECT o.Package_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS o " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE o.Stereotype = '"& StereotypeName &"' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND o.name='"& ElementName &"' "
' Execute query to get all packages of name `ElementName` and stereotype `StereotypeName` result = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlGetElement) ' Session.Output "XML query is" & result
connectorIDs = convertQueryResultToArray(result) ' Iterate over connectorIDs array and get the first result for each connectorID in connectorIDs on error resume next ' Get the corresponding package based on connectorID set getCorrespondingElement = Repository.GetPackageByID(connectorID) Session.Output "Master Package " & getCorrespondingElement.name if err.Number <> 0 or getCorrespondingElement is nothing then Session.Output "ERROR: Package "& ElementName & " not found." set getParentPackage = Masterpackage break on error goto 0 end if ' Exit the loop after getting the first result exit for next ' Return the corresponding package set getParentPackage = getCorrespondingElement end function
' NOT working ' Search for a package by name with API within all packages and sub-packages Function GetPackageByName(packageName, parentPackage) Dim package As EA.Package For Each package In parentPackage.Packages If package.Name = packageName Then Set GetPackageByName = package Exit Function Else Dim foundPackage Set foundPackage = GetPackageByName(packageName, package) If Not foundPackage Is Nothing Then Set GetPackageByName = foundPackage Exit Function End If End If Next Set GetPackageByName = Nothing End Function

option explicit !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC EAScriptLib.VBScript-Logging ' ' Script Name: SortbyAlias ' Author: Giu Platania ' Purpose: Sort elements contained in the selected package from the Project Browser by the Alias name ASC ' Date: 2023 11 ' sub SortDictionary (objDict) ' constants Const dictKey = 1 Const dictItem = 2 ' variables Dim strDict() Dim objKey Dim strKey,strItem Dim X,Y,Z ' get the dictionary count Z = objDict.Count ' sorting needs more than one item If Z > 1 Then ' create an array to store dictionary information ReDim strDict(Z,2) X = 0 ' populate the string array For Each objKey In objDict strDict(X,dictKey) = CStr(objKey) strDict(X,dictItem) = CStr(objDict(objKey)) X = X + 1 Next ' perform a a shell sort of the string array For X = 0 To (Z - 2) For Y = X To (Z - 1) If StrComp(strDict(X,1),strDict(Y,1),vbTextCompare) > 0 Then strKey = strDict(X,dictKey) strItem = strDict(X,dictItem) strDict(X,dictKey) = strDict(Y,dictKey) strDict(X,dictItem) = strDict(Y,dictItem) strDict(Y,dictKey) = strKey strDict(Y,dictItem) = strItem End If Next Next ' erase the contents of the dictionary object objDict.RemoveAll ' repopulate the dictionary with the sorted information For X = 0 To (Z - 1) objDict.Add strDict(X,dictKey), strDict(X,dictItem) Next ' sort the package elements based on the new sorting order dim newOrder newOrder = 0 dim theItem dim eaelement for each objKey in objDict theItem = objDict.Item(objKey) Set eaelement = Repository.GetElementByGuid(theItem) 'change the position of the element in the package to the new sorting order value eaelement.TreePos = CLng(newOrder) eaelement.Update() newOrder = newOrder + 1 next end if end sub
sub sortElementsbyAlias (selectedPackage) LOGInfo("Processing selected package " & selectedPackage.Name) dim elements as EA.Collection dim i dim processedElements set processedElements = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary" ) set elements = selectedPackage.Elements for i = 0 to elements.Count - 1 dim currentElement as EA.Element set currentElement = elements.GetAt( i ) LOGInfo("Processing " & currentElement.Type & " no " & i & " with alias " & currentElement.Alias & "(" & currentElement.ElementGUID & ")") processedElements.Add currentElement.Alias, currentElement.ElementGUID next LOGInfo("Sorting package elements") SortDictionary processedElements end sub ' ' Project Browser Script main function ' sub OnProjectBrowserScript() Repository.ClearOutput "Script" LOGInfo( "Starting SortbyAlias script" ) LOGInfo( "==============================" ) ' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() select case treeSelectedType case otPackage ' Code for when a package is selected dim thePackage as EA.Package set thePackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() sortElementsbyAlias thePackage Repository.RefreshModelView (thePackage.PackageID) case else ' Error message Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK end select end sub OnProjectBrowserScript

option explicit !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC EAScriptLib.VBScript-Logging ' ' Script Name: SortbyTaggedValue_SortingOrder ' Author: Giu.platania ' Purpose: Sort elements contained in the selected package from the Project Browser by the tagged value SortingOrder value ' current version contains a Function to transform property into integer format when those are in a eTOM like format ' e.g. propertiesArray = Array("7", "7.4", "7.4.1", "7.4.1.1", "7.4.1.2") ' Date: 25/05/2023 ' ' SortDictionary subroutine sorts the keys of a given dictionary in ascending order ' and repositions elements in an Enterprise Architect model based on the sorted order
dim taggedValueName taggedValueName = "Process Identifier" sub SortDictionary (objDict)
' Declare dictionary key and item constants Const dictKey = 1 Const dictItem = 2
' Declare variables Dim strDict() Dim objKey Dim strKey,strItem Dim X,Y,Z
' Get the count of items in the dictionary Z = objDict.Count
' Proceed if the dictionary has more than one item If Z > 1 Then ' Create a 2D array to hold dictionary key-item pairs ReDim strDict(Z,2) X = 0
' Populate the array with keys and items from the dictionary For Each objKey In objDict strDict(X,dictKey) = CStr(objKey) strDict(X,dictItem) = CStr(objDict(objKey)) X = X + 1 Next
' Implement shell sort on the array based on the keys For X = 0 To (Z - 2) For Y = X To (Z - 1) If StrComp(strDict(X,1),strDict(Y,1),vbTextCompare) > 0 Then ' If the key at index X is greater than the key at index Y, swap them strKey = strDict(X,dictKey) strItem = strDict(X,dictItem) strDict(X,dictKey) = strDict(Y,dictKey) strDict(X,dictItem) = strDict(Y,dictItem) strDict(Y,dictKey) = strKey strDict(Y,dictItem) = strItem End If Next Next
' Clear the original dictionary objDict.RemoveAll
' Repopulate the dictionary with the sorted key-item pairs For X = 0 To (Z - 1) objDict.Add strDict(X,dictKey), strDict(X,dictItem) Next
' Initialize the new order variable dim newOrder newOrder = 0 dim theItem dim eaelement
' For each key in the sorted dictionary, find the corresponding Enterprise Architect element ' and reposition it in the model based on the new order for each objKey in objDict theItem = objDict.Item(objKey) Set eaelement = Repository.GetElementByGuid(theItem)
' Change the tree position of the element to the new order value eaelement.TreePos = CLng(newOrder) eaelement.Update() newOrder = newOrder + 1 next end if end sub
sub SortbyTaggedValue_SortingOrder (selectedPackage) LOGInfo("Processing selected package " & selectedPackage.Name) LOGInfo("sorting TAG is " & taggedValueName) dim elements as EA.Collection dim i dim processedElements dim aLong ' as Long set processedElements = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary" ) set elements = selectedPackage.Elements for i = 0 to elements.Count - 1 dim currentElement as EA.Element set currentElement = elements.GetAt( i ) dim tag as EA.TaggedValue set tag = currentElement.TaggedValues.GetByName(taggedValueName) if tag Is Nothing then 'nothing to do : the element will be at the beginning LOGInfo("tag is nothing for" & currentElement.Name & " no " & i & "( " & currentElement.Type & ")") processedElements.Add "0", currentElement.ElementGUID else LOGInfo("Processing " & currentElement.Name & " no " & i & " TV= " & tag.Value & " (" & currentElement.ElementGUID & ")") tag.Value = TransformProperty(tag.Value) aLong = CLng(tag.Value) LOGInfo("Long is " & aLong) processedElements.Add aLong , currentElement.ElementGUID end if next LOGInfo("Sorting package elements") SortDictionary processedElements 'SortEtomArray processedElements end sub
' Function to transform property into integer format when those are in a eTOM like format ' e.g. propertiesArray = Array("7", "7.4", "7.4.1", "7.4.1.1", "7.4.1.2")
Function TransformProperty2(property) Dim parts parts = Split(property, ".") Dim transformedParts ReDim transformedParts(Ubound(parts))
Dim i For i = 0 To Ubound(parts) transformedParts(i) = CInt(parts(i)) Next TransformProperty = Join(transformedParts, ".") End Function
' Function to transform property into padded format when those are in an eTOM like format ' e.g. propertiesArray = Array("7", "7.4", "7.4.1", "7.4.1.1", "7.4.1.2")
Function TransformProperty(property) Dim parts dim partcount
parts = Split(property, ".")
If Ubound(parts) < 5 Then Dim transformedParts ReDim transformedParts(Ubound(parts))
Dim i For i = 0 To Ubound(parts) ' Pad each segment to 5 digits width by adding leading zeros transformedParts(i) = Right("00000" & parts(i), 1) Next
' Return the joined parts as a single number TransformProperty = CLng(Join(transformedParts, "")) Else ' If a part has 5 or more characters, bypass the padding and use it as is If IsNumeric(Join(parts, "")) Then TransformProperty = CLng(Join(parts, "")) Else Randomize ' Initialize random-number generator. TransformProperty = Int((1000000 - 1 + 1) * Rnd + 1) End If End If End Function
' Sort the array using transformed properties function SortEtomArray(propertiesArray) dim dicitionary set dicitionary = CreateObject( "Scripting.Dictionary" )
Dim i, j, temp
' Iterate over the array For i = 0 To propertiesArray.Count - 2 For j = i + 1 To propertiesArray.Count - 1 ' Convert to long instead of integer and compare If CLng(TransformProperty(propertiesArray.GetAt(i))) > CLng(TransformProperty(propertiesArray.GetAt(j))) Then ' Swap elements temp = propertiesArray.GetAt(i) propertiesArray.SetAt i, propertiesArray.GetAt(j) propertiesArray.SetAt j, temp End If Next Next
' Output the sorted array For i = 0 To propertiesArray.Count - 1 Session.Output(propertiesArray.GetAt(i)) Next end Function
' ' Project Browser Script main function ' sub OnProjectBrowserScript() Repository.ClearOutput "Script" LOGInfo( "Starting SortbyTaggedValue_SortingOrder script" ) LOGInfo( "==============================" ) ' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() select case treeSelectedType case otPackage ' Code for when a package is selected dim thePackage as EA.Package set thePackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() SortbyTaggedValue_SortingOrder thePackage Repository.RefreshModelView (thePackage.PackageID) case else ' Error message Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK end select end sub OnProjectBrowserScript

sub Test(packageGUID) dim package As EA.Package dim levelList ' as Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim element as EA.Element Session.Output "starting DMM diagram" set package = Repository.GetPackageByGuid(packageGUID) set levelList = getDiagramLevelList Session.Output "found " + cstr(package.Elements.Count) + " elements!" for each element in package.Elements if element.MetaType = "Capability" then createNestedHierarchyDiagram element, levelList, "Custom", false end if next end sub
function getDiagramLevelList
dim levelList ' as Scripting.Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim level1 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level2 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level3 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level4 ' as HierarchyLevel
set levelList = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
' *** FIRST LEVEL *** ' *** FIRST LEVEL *** set level1 = New HierarchyLevel
level1.numObjects = 2 level1.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level1.elementMetatype = "Capability" level1.objectHeight = 100 level1.objectWidth = 200 level1.horizOffset = 10 level1.horizSpace = 20 level1.vertOffset = 10 level1.vertSpace = 20 level1.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level1.objectStyle.fontSize = 14 level1.objectStyle.fontBold = "1" ' true

' begin level 1 aggregated function element profile, nested relation profile dim DomainNested set DomainNested = new RelationProfile DomainNested.nestingType = "Nested"
DomainProfile.relationProfiles.Add 1, DomainNested ' end level 1 aggregated function element profile, nested relation profile ' end level 1 aggregated function element profile
levelList.Add 1, level1
set level2 = new hierarchylevel
level2.numobjects = 3 level2.flowdirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level2.elementMetatype = "Aggregated Function" level2.objectHeight = 110 level2.objectWidth = 230 level2.horizOffset = 10 level2.horizSpace = 10 level2.vertOffset = 80 level2.vertSpace = 10 level2.objectstyle.fontname = "Calibri" level2.objectstyle.fontsize = 10

' begin level 2 function element profile, AF relation profile dim L2AFRelatedFunction set L2AFRelatedFunction = new RelationProfile L2AFRelatedFunction.nestingType = "Related" L2AFRelatedFunction.relationType = "Aggregation" L2AFRelatedFunction.relationStereotype = "TMF_AFAggregatesFunction" L2AFRelatedFunction.relatedType = "Class" L2AFRelatedFunction.relatedStereotype = "TMF_Function"
L2AFProfile.relationProfiles.Add 1, L2AFRelatedFunction ' end level 2 function element profile, AF relation profile
' begin level 2 function element profile, AF relation profile dim L2AFRelatedAD set L2AFRelatedAD = new RelationProfile L2AFRelatedAD.nestingType = "Related" L2AFRelatedAD.relationType = "Aggregation" L2AFRelatedAD.relationStereotype = "TMF_DomainAggregatesFunction" L2AFRelatedAD.relatedType = "Class" L2AFRelatedAD.relatedStereotype = "TMF_AF"
L2AFProfile.relationProfiles.Add 2, L2AFRelatedAD ' end level 2 function element profile, AF relation profile
level2.elementProfiles.Add 1, L2AFProfile ' end level 2 function element profile
levellist.add 2, level2
' *** 3rd LEVEL *** set level3 = New HierarchyLevel
level3.numObjects = 4 level3.flowDirection = TOP_DOWN_FLOW_DIRECTION level3.elementMetatype = "Function" level3.objectHeight = 60 level3.objectWidth = 180 level3.horizOffset = 30 level3.horizSpace = 3 level3.vertOffset = 50 level3.vertSpace = 3 level3.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level3.objectStyle.fontSize = 9

' begin level 3 function element profile, AF relation profile dim L3FunctionRelatedAF set L3FunctionRelatedAF = new RelationProfile L3FunctionRelatedAF.nestingType = "Related" L3FunctionRelatedAF.relationType = "Aggregation" L3FunctionRelatedAF.relationStereotype = "TMF_AFAggregatesFunction" L3FunctionRelatedAF.relatedType = "Class" L3FunctionRelatedAF.relatedStereotype = "TMF_Function"
L3FunctionProfile.relationProfiles.Add 1, L3FunctionRelatedAF ' end level 3 function element profile, function relation profile

level4.elementMetatype = "Requirement" level4.objectHeight = 30 level4.objectWidth = 85 level4.horizOffset = 20 level4.horizSpace = 3 level4.vertOffset = 50 level4.vertSpace = 3 level4.nestingType = "Related" level4.relationType = "Aggregation" level4.relationStereotype = "TMF_AFAggregatesFunction" level4.relatedType = "Class" level4.relatedStereotype = "TMF_Function" ' level4.objectStyle.fillColor = colorWhite level4.objectStyle.lineWidth = 1 level4.objectStyle.lineColor = colorBlack level4.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level4.objectStyle.fontSize = 8 'level4.objectStyle.fontColor = colorBlack

' Script Name: Create FF Compositions ' Author: Giu Platania ' Purpose: THis script will traverse a project tree and extract all the element with a certain stereotype ' It will then get the children of the current element and create a relationship between the owner and the child ' Date: 2023.12 ' TODO: add check to avoid duplicate relationship ' TODO: ' retrieve element ' retrieve Tagged Value called RefGUID ' get corresponding package ' get all element in that package
Dim componentElementCount, componentControllerClassCreated 'Used to check if there are any use case element are available and throw an error when no use case element is present. componentElementCount = 0 componentControllerClassCreated = 0 dim Stereo, connType, connStereotype Stereo = "TMF_Function" connType = "Aggregation" connStereotype = "TMF::TMF_AFAggregatesFunction"
'
Function createRelationship(fromElement) dim childElement as EA.Element dim childElementList 'as Scripting.Dictionary set childElementList = getChildElementList(fromElement,Stereo) for each childElement in fromElement.Elements if childElement.Stereotype = stereo then addConnectorMDG childElement, connType, connStereotype, fromElement Session.Output( "created relationship from " + childElement.Name + " to " + fromElement.name ) fromElement.Update childElement.Update end if next end function
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
' Get the type of element selected in the Project Browser dim treeSelectedType treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType() select case treeSelectedType case otPackage dim basePackageElement as EA.Element dim packagesubElement as EA.Element 'level 1 dim subElement as EA.Element ''level 2 dim subsubElement as EA.Element '' level 3 dim subsubsubElement as EA.Element '' level 4 dim subsubsubsubElement as EA.Element '' level 5 dim subsubsubsubsubElement as EA.Element '' level 6
dim packageElementIndex, packageElementCount set basePackageElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() Session.Output( "package " + basePackageElement.Name) packageElementCount = basePackageElement.Elements.Count - 1 set basePackageElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject()
for packageElementIndex = 0 to packageElementCount '''level 1 set packagesubElement = basePackageElement.Elements.GetAt(packageElementIndex) createRelationship(packagesubElement) ''level 2 for each subElement in packagesubElement.Elements createRelationship(subElement) '' level 3 if subElement.Elements.Count > 0 then for each subsubElement in subElement.Elements createRelationship(subsubElement) '' lev 4 if subsubElement.Elements.Count > 0 then for each subsubsubElement in subsubElement.Elements createRelationship(subsubsubElement) ''lev 5 if subsubsubElement.Elements.Count > 0 then for each subsubsubsubElement in subsubsubElement.Elements createRelationship(subsubsubsubElement) next componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 end if '' lev 5 next componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 end if '' lev 4 next end If '' level 3 componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 next componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 next 'packageElementIndex case otElement 'element selected dim Element as EA.Element set packagesubElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() createRelationship(packagesubElement) componentElementCount =componentElementCount + 1 ''level 2 for each subElement in packagesubElement.Elements createRelationship(subElement) '' level 3 if subElement.Elements.Count > 0 then for each subsubElement in subElement.Elements createRelationship(subsubElement) '' lev 4 if subsubElement.Elements.Count > 0 then for each subsubsubElement in subsubElement.Elements createRelationship(subsubsubElement) ''lev 5 if subsubsubElement.Elements.Count > 0 then for each subsubsubsubElement in subsubsubElement.Elements createRelationship(subsubsubsubElement) next componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 end if '' lev 5 next componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 end if '' lev 4 next end If '' level 3 componentElementCount = componentElementCount + 1 next end select
if componentElementCount > 0 then Session.Prompt "relationship created for for " & componentElementCount & " " & Stereo, promptOK else Session.Prompt "relationship can ONLY be created for elements of type" & Stereo, promptOK end if end sub

' Script to scale size and position all diagram objects (but not connectors) by a specified factor. ' <1 will create smaller objects ' !INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript
sub resizeDiagramObjects( scaleFactor)
dim currentDiagram as EA.Diagram dim diagramObject as EA.DiagramObject
set currentDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram() if not currentDiagram is nothing then Repository.SaveDiagram currentDiagram.DiagramID
for each diagramObject in currentDiagram.DiagramObjects diagramObject.top = diagramObject.top * scaleFactor diagramObject.bottom = diagramObject.bottom * scaleFactor diagramObject.left = diagramObject.left * scaleFactor diagramObject.right = diagramObject.right * scaleFactor diagramObject.Update next Repository.ReloadDiagram currentDiagram.DiagramID else Session.Prompt "This script requires a diagram to be visible", promptOK end if end sub
dim scaleFactor 'as Double
scaleFactor = InputBox( "Enter scaling factor (as a decimal)", "Resize Diagram Objects", "1.5")
if scaleFactor <> vbNullString then if IsNumeric(scaleFactor) then resizeDiagramObjects scaleFactor else Session.Prompt "Scaling factor must be a decimal number greater than zero.", promptOK end if end if

' Script Name: Elements -> create API Operations ' Author: Natha Paquette ' Purpose: create appropriate Operations for API elements based on connection to JSON Schema ' Date: 26/03/2024 '

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Utils.Model Management Utilities ' ' This code has been included from the default Diagram Script template. ' If you wish to modify this template, it is located in the Config\Script Templates ' directory of your EA install path. ' ' Script Name: Transform Class Into Schema ' Author: ' Purpose: Transforms a selected class in a diagram into a JSON schema, including all connectors and properties. ' Date: 10/04/2024
sub OnDiagramScript()
dim currentDiagram as EA.Diagram dim selectedObject as EA.DiagramObject dim selectedElement as EA.Element dim control as EA.Element dim controlName 'as string dim package as EA.Package dim flag ' as boolean dim jsonElement as EA.Element ' flag identifies whether schema has been generated already flag = false set currentDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram() if currentDiagram.SelectedObjects.Count = 1 then for each selectedObject in currentDiagram.SelectedObjects set selectedElement = Repository.GetElementByID(selectedObject.ElementID) if selectedElement.Type = "Class" then Session.Output "Class found, starting conversion....." set package = Repository.GetPackageByID(selectedElement.PackageID) ' iterate the elements in the package of the selected element for each control in package.Elements controlName = selectedElement.Name controlName = Replace (controlName, " ", "") ' if the selected element has already been generated, ignore it and continue if control.Stereotype = "TMF_JSON_Schema" and control.Name = controlName then Session.Output "This class already has a JSON element" set jsonElement = control flag = true exit for end if Next ' if the JSON Schema has not yet been generated, generate it if flag = false then set jsonElement = TransferClass(selectedElement, currentDiagram) end if ' add any aggregations SearchForAggregation selectedElement, currentDiagram
' add any associations CreateAssociation selectedElement, jsonElement
Repository.ReloadDiagram(currentDiagram.diagramID) else Session.Prompt "The diagram object must be a class", promptOK end if flag = false next else Session.Prompt "This script requires an object to be selected in a diagram to be visible", promptOK end if Session.Output "done" end sub
' creates a json element function TransferClass (element, diagram) dim jsonElement as EA.Element dim package as EA.Package
set package = Repository.GetPackageByID (element.PackageID) set jsonElement = Package.Elements.AddNew (Element.Name, "TMF_JSON_Schema") ' jsonElement.Stereotype = "TMF_JSON_Schema" jsonElement.StereotypeEx = "TMF_JSON_Schema,dModelClass" jsonElement.Name = Element.Name jsonElement.Name = replace(jsonElement.Name, " ", "") jsonElement.Notes = Element.Notes jsonElement.Gentype = "UML2" jsonElement.Update Session.Output "JSONSchema Created" CopyAttributes element, jsonElement Session.Output "Attributes copied" CreateRealizationConn element, jsonElement Session.Output "Realisation connector created" CreateDiagramObject jsonElement Session.Output "Diagram object created" set TransferClass = jsonElement end function
sub CopyAttributes (element, jsonElement) dim i ' as index dim newAttr as EA.Attribute dim attrVal as EA.Attribute
for i = 0 to element.Attributes.Count - 1 set attrVal = element.Attributes.GetAt(i) set newAttr = jsonElement.Attributes.AddNew (attrVal.Name, attrVal.Type) newAttr.Name = replace (newAttr.Name, " ", "") newAttr.Stereotype = attrVal.Stereotype newAttr.Update jsonElement.Attributes.Refresh next
end sub
sub CreateRealizationConn (source, target) dim newConnector as EA.Connector
set newConnector = source.Connectors.AddNew ("Realization", "Realization") newConnector.ClientID = target.ElementID newConnector.SupplierID = source.ElementID newConnector.Update source.Connectors.Refresh target.Connectors.Refresh end sub
sub CreateDiagramObject (jsonElement) dim dObject as EA.DiagramObject dim diagram as EA.Diagram
set diagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram set dObject = diagram.DiagramObjects.AddNew ("", "") dObject.ElementID = jsonElement.ElementID
dObject.Update() diagram.Update() diagram.DiagramObjects.Refresh() end sub
sub SearchForAggregation (element, diagram) dim i ' as index dim generalization as EA.Connector dim aggregator as EA.Element dim package as EA.Package dim control as EA.Element dim jsonControl as EA.Element dim controlName 'as string dim flag 'as boolean
for each generalization in element.Connectors if generalization.MetaType = "Generalization" then Session.Output "Generalization found, transferring aggregator element....." set aggregator = Repository.GetElementByID(generalization.SupplierID) set package = Repository.GetPackageByID(element.PackageID) ' for each control in package.Elements ' controlName = aggregator.Name ' controlName = Replace (controlName, " ", "") ' if control.Stereotype = "TMF_JSON_Schema" and control.Name = controlName then ' Session.Output "This class already has a JSON element" ' flag = true ' exit for ' end if ' Next set jsonControl = findJsonElement(aggregator) if jsonControl is nothing then TransferClass aggregator, diagram end if CreateGeneralizationConn aggregator, element end if next end sub
sub CreateGeneralizationConn (sourceClass, clientClass) Session.Output "Creating Generalization connector" dim newConnector as EA.Connector dim source as EA.Element dim client as EA.Element dim flag 'as boolean dim control as EA.Element dim connector as EA.Connector dim package as EA.Package dim controlName 'as string
set package = Repository.GetPackageByID(clientClass.PackageID)
set source = findJsonElement(sourceClass)
set client = findJsonElement(clientClass)
for each connector in source.Connectors if connector.MetaType = "Schema Generalization" and connector.ClientID = Client.ElementID then Session.Output "Generalization relationship already exists" Flag = true exit for end if next
if flag = false then set newConnector = sourceClass.Connectors.AddNew ("", "Generalization" ) newConnector.ClientID = Client.ElementID newConnector.SupplierID = Source.ElementID newConnector.Stereotype = "TMF_SchemaGeneralizesSchema" newConnector.Update end if
end sub
' This method creates the schemas associated with the first level of relationships ' assuming source json element already exists. sub CreateAssociation (sourceClass, sourceJsonElem) ' define variables dim navigableConnectorsList dim clientElementList dim targetElem as EA.Element dim targetJsonElem as EA.Element dim connector as EA.Connector
' get all supplier associations from sourceClass and transfer them to json schema associations set navigableConnectorsList = getNavigableConnectors(sourceClass, "Association", "Class") TransferRelations navigableConnectorsList, sourceClass, sourceJsonElem, "Association", "TMF_Schema_Associates_Schema"
end sub
sub TransferRelations (ConnectorGuidList, sourceElement, SourceJsonElem, relType, relStereotype) dim targetElem as EA.Element dim targetJsonElem as EA.Element dim targetName ' as string dim connectorGuid ' as string dim connector as EA.Connector dim sourceConnector as EA.Connector dim connectorAttribute as EA.Attribute dim targetConnectorAttribute as EA.Attribute dim isSupplier dim searchConnector as EA.Connector dim bounds dim upperBound ' as string dim lowerBound ' as string dim searchName ' as string
' iterate associations and create for each connectorGuid in ConnectorGuidList set connector = nothing
' search for element w/ target name and stereotype set sourceConnector = Repository.GetConnectorByGuid(connectorGuid)
' check if the sourceElement is the client or supplier if sourceConnector.ClientID = sourceElement.ElementID then isSupplier = false set targetElem = Repository.GetElementByID(sourceConnector.SupplierID) elseif sourceConnector.SupplierID = sourceElement.ElementID then isSupplier = true set targetElem = Repository.GetElementByID(sourceConnector.ClientID) end if
' try to find existing json element set targetJsonElem = findJsonElement(targetElem)
' if not found, create element and association if targetJsonElem is nothing then ' create element set targetJsonElem = TransferClass(targetElem, Repository.GetCurrentDiagram()) end if
' create default name if none exists if sourceConnector.Name = "" then searchName = SourceJsonElem.Name+"_Associates_"+targetJsonElem.Name else searchName = sourceConnector.Name end if
' check if the connector already exists for each searchConnector in targetJsonElem.Connectors ' if the connector is found leave connector set to this target if searchConnector.Name = searchName then ' if relationship is found to have already been created, exit set connector = searchConnector exit for end if next
' if the connector is not found create it if connector is nothing then if isSupplier = false then set connector = addConnector(sourceJsonElem, relType, relStereotype, targetJsonElem) else set connector = addConnector(targetJsonElem, relType, relStereotype, sourceJsonElem) end if end if
' copy all connector properties from the source to the target if a new connector has been created copyConnector sourceConnector,connector copyConnectorEnd sourceConnector.ClientEnd, connector.ClientEnd copyConnectorEnd sourceConnector.SupplierEnd, connector.SupplierEnd connector.Name = searchName connector.Update
' add attribute to schema set connectorAttribute = setAttribute(SourceJsonElem, connector.Name, "") connectorAttribute.Type = targetJsonElem.Name connectorAttribute.ClassifierID = targetJsonElem.ElementID if isSupplier = false then connectorAttribute.UpperBound = getConnectorEndUpperBound(connector.SupplierEnd) connectorAttribute.LowerBound = getConnectorEndLowerBound(connector.SupplierEnd) else connectorAttribute.UpperBound = getConnectorEndUpperBound(connector.ClientEnd) connectorAttribute.LowerBound = getConnectorEndLowerBound(connector.ClientEnd) end if connectorAttribute.Update SourceJsonElem.Update
' add attribute to target schema if reverse is navigable if isSupplier=true then if sourceConnector.SupplierEnd.Navigable<>"Non-Navigable" then set targetConnectorAttribute = setAttribute(targetJsonElem, connector.Name, "") targetConnectorAttribute.Type = SourceJsonElem.Name targetConnectorAttribute.ClassifierID = SourceJsonElem.ElementID targetConnectorAttribute.UpperBound = getConnectorEndUpperBound(connector.SupplierEnd) targetConnectorAttribute.LowerBound = getConnectorEndLowerBound(connector.SupplierEnd) targetConnectorAttribute.Update targetJsonElem.Update end if else if sourceConnector.ClientEnd.Navigable<>"Non-Navigable" then set targetConnectorAttribute = setAttribute(targetJsonElem, connector.Name, "") targetConnectorAttribute.Type = SourceJsonElem.Name targetConnectorAttribute.ClassifierID = SourceJsonElem.ElementID targetConnectorAttribute.UpperBound = getConnectorEndUpperBound(connector.ClientEnd) targetConnectorAttribute.LowerBound = getConnectorEndLowerBound(connector.ClientEnd) targetConnectorAttribute.Update targetJsonElem.Update end if end if connector.Update next end sub
function findJsonElement(element) dim name dim jsonElem ' dim element as EA.Element dim connector as EA.Connector dim candidateElem as EA.Element dim condition dim condition2 set candidateElem = nothing name = Replace(element.Name, " ", "") set jsonElem = lookupElement(name, "TMF_JSON_Schema", "Class") set findJsonElement = jsonElem ' iterate connectors for each connector in element.Connectors ' find connector which is realization with this element as the supplier condition = connector.SupplierID = element.ElementID and connector.MetaType = "Realisation" if condition then ' check the name and the stereotype of the element on the client end of the relationships set candidateElem = Repository.GetElementByID(connector.ClientID) condition2 = candidateElem.Stereotype = "TMF_JSON_Schema" and candidateElem.Name = name if condition2 then set findJsonElement = candidateElem exit for end if end if next if candidateElem is nothing then set findJsonElement = nothing end if end function
OnDiagramScript

!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Wrappers.Include
' Author: Geert Bellekens ' Purpose: Saves all scripts in a given folder on the file system ' Date: 2015-12-07 ' sub main dim script set script = New Script dim allScripts, allGroups set allGroups = Nothing 'get the folder from the user dim folder, shell Set shell = CreateObject( "Shell.Application" ) Set folder = new FileSystemFolder set folder = folder.getUserSelectedFolder("") if not folder is nothing then set allScripts = script.getAllScripts(allGroups) Session.Output "allGroups.Count: " & allGroups.Count end if for each script in allScripts Session.Output "filename: " & folder.FullPath & script.Path & "\" & script.Name & ".vbs" dim file set file = New TextFile file.FullPath = folder.FullPath & script.Path & "\" & script.Name & ".vbs" 'first make sure the code indicator is added to the code script.addGroupToCode 'then save the script with the group indicator file.Contents = script.Code file.Save next end sub
main

'[path=\Framework\Tools\Script Management] '[group=Script Management]
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Wrappers.Include !INC EAScriptLib.VBScript-GUID
' Author: Geert Bellekens ' Purpose: Loads scripts from the file systems and stores them in Enterprise Architect ' Date: 2015-12-07 ' sub main dim selectedFolder,file, allScripts, allGroups,script, overwriteExisting set selectedFolder = new FileSystemFolder set selectedFolder = selectedFolder.getUserSelectedFolder("") overwriteExisting = "undecided" if not selectedFolder is nothing then set allGroups = Nothing set script = new Script 'first get all existing scripts and groups set allScripts = Script.getAllScripts(allGroups) 'get the scripts from the folder and its subfolders getScriptsFromFolder selectedFolder, allGroups, allScripts, overwriteExisting end if end sub
'gets all the scripts from the given folder and its subfolders (if any) function getScriptsFromFolder(selectedFolder, allGroups, allScripts, overwriteExisting) dim script, subFolder for each file in selectedFolder.TextFiles Session.Output "FileName: " & file.FileName 'Session.Output "Code: " & file.Contents set script = getScriptFromFile(file, allGroups, allScripts,overwriteExisting) if overwriteExisting = vbCancel then exit for end if next 'then process subfolders if not overwriteExisting = vbCancel then for each subFolder in selectedFolder.SubFolders getScriptsFromFolder subFolder, allGroups, allScripts, overwriteExisting next end if end function
function getScriptFromFile(file, allGroups, allScripts,overwriteExisting) dim script, newScript, foundMatch, newScriptGroupName, group, foundGroup foundMatch = false foundGroup = false set group = nothing set script = Nothing if file.Extension = "vbs" then for each script in allScripts set newScript = new Script newScript.Name = file.FileNameWithoutExtension newScript.Code = file.Contents newScriptGroupName = newScript.GroupInNameCode 'if the groupname was not found in the code we use the name of the package if len(newScriptGroupName) = 0 then newScriptGroupName = file.Folder.Name end if 'check the name of the script if script.Name = newScript.Name then 'check if there is a groupname defined in the file if script.Group.Name = newScriptGroupName then 'we have a match foundMatch = true set group = script.Group exit for end if end if next if not foundMatch then 'script did not exist yet 'figure out if the group exists already for each group in allGroups.Items if group.Name = newScriptGroupName then 'found the group 'add the group to the new script newScript.Group = group foundGroup = true exit for end if next 'if the group doesn't exist yet we have to create it if not foundGroup then set group = new ScriptGroup group.Name = newScriptGroupName group.GUID = GUIDGenerateGUID() group.GroupType = gtNormal 'create the Group in the database group.Create 'refresh allGroups Session.Output "allGroups.Count before: " & allGroups.Count set allGroups = group.GetAllGroups() Session.Output "allGroups.Count after: " & allGroups.Count 'add the group to the script newScript.Group = group end if 'Now we have to create the script newScript.GUID = GUIDGenerateGUID() newScript.Create set script = newScript else if overwriteExisting = "undecided" then overwriteExisting = Msgbox("Do you want to update existing scripts?", vbYesNoCancel+vbQuestion, "Update existing scripts") if overwriteExisting = vbYes then script.Code = newScript.Code script.Update end if end if end if
end if set getScriptFromFile = script end function
main

'[path=\Framework\Wrappers\Scripting] '[group=Wrappers]
'option explicit
!INC Utils.Include
'Author: Geert Bellekens 'Date: 2015-12-07
'for some reason all scripts in the database have this value in the column scriptCategory Const scriptCategory = "605A62F7-BCD0-4845-A8D0-7DC45B4D2E3F"
Class Script Private m_Name Private m_Code Private m_Group Private m_Id Private m_GUID
Private Sub Class_Initialize m_Name = "" m_Code = "" m_Id = "" set m_Group = Nothing End Sub
' Name property. Public Property Get Name Name = m_Name End Property Public Property Let Name(value) m_Name = value End Property
' Code property. Public Property Get Code Code = m_Code End Property Public Property Let Code(value) m_Code = value End Property
' Id property. Public Property Get Id Id = m_Id End Property Public Property Let Id(value) m_Id = value End Property
' GUID property. Public Property Get GUID GUID = m_GUID End Property Public Property Let GUID(value) m_GUID = value End Property
' Path property. Public Property Get Path Path = getPathFromCode if len(Path) < 1 then Path = "\" & me.Group.Name end if End Property
' Group property. Public Property Get Group set Group = m_Group End Property Public Property Let Group(value) set m_Group = value 'add the script to the group m_Group.Scripts.Add me End Property
' GroupNameInCode property Public Property Get GroupInNameCode GroupInNameCode = getGroupFromCode() End Property
' Gets all scripts stored in the model Public function getAllScripts(allGroups) dim resultArray, scriptGroup,row,queryResult set scriptGroup = new scriptGroup set allGroups = scriptGroup.getAllGroups() dim allScripts set allScripts = CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList") dim sqlGet sqlGet = "select s.ScriptID, s.Notes, s.Script,ps.Script as SCRIPTGROUP, ps.Notes as GROUPNOTES, ps.ScriptID as GroupID, ps.ScriptName as GroupGUID, s.ScriptName as ScriptGUID " & _ " from t_script s " & _ " inner join t_script ps on s.ScriptAuthor = ps.ScriptName " & _ " where s.notes like '<Script Name=" & getWC() & "'" queryResult = Repository.SQLQuery(sqlGet) resultArray = convertQueryResultToArray(queryResult) dim id, notes, code, group, name, groupNotes, groupID, groupGUID, scriptGUID dim i For i = LBound(resultArray) To UBound(resultArray) id = resultArray(i,0) notes = resultArray(i,1) code = resultArray(i,2) group = resultArray(i,3) groupNotes = resultArray(i,4) groupID = resultArray(i,5) groupGUID = resultArray(i,6) scriptGUID = resultArray(i,7) if len(notes) > 0 then 'first get or create the group if allGroups.Exists(groupID) then set scriptGroup = allGroups(groupID) else set scriptGroup = new ScriptGroup scriptGroup.Name = group scriptGroup.Id = groupID scriptGroup.GUID = groupGUID scriptGroup.setGroupTypeFromNotes groupNotes 'add the group to the dictionary allGroups.Add groupID, scriptGroup end if 'then make the script name = getNameFromNotes(notes) dim script set script = New Script script.Id = id script.Name = name script.Code = code script.GUID = scriptGUID 'add the group to the script script.Group = scriptGroup 'add the script to the list allScripts.Add script end if next set getAllScripts = allScripts End function
'the notes contain= <Script Name="MyScriptName" Type="Internal" Language="JavaScript"/> 'so the name is the second part when splitted by double quotes private function getNameFromNotes(notes) dim parts parts = split(notes,"""") getNameFromNotes = parts(1) end function
'the path is defined in the code as '[path=\directory\subdirectory] private function getPathFromCode() getPathFromCode = getKeyValue("path") end function 'the Group is defined in the code as '[group=NameOfTheGroup] public function getGroupFromCode() getGroupFromCode = getKeyValue("group") end function
'the key-value pair is defined in the code as '[keyName=value] public function getKeyValue(keyName) dim returnValue returnValue = "" 'initialise emtpy dim keyIndicator, startKey, endKey, tempValue keyIndicator = "[" & keyName & "=" startKey = instr(me.Code, keyIndicator) + len(keyIndicator) if startKey > len(keyIndicator) then endKey = instr(startKey, me.Code, "]") if endKey > startKey then tempValue = mid(me.code,startKey, endKey - startKey) 'filter out newline in case someone forgot to add the closing "]" if instr(tempValue,vbNewLine) = 0 and instr(tempValue,vbLF) = 0 then returnValue = tempValue end if end if end if getKeyValue = returnValue end function
public function addGroupToCode() dim groupFromCode groupFromCode = me.getGroupFromCode() if not len(groupFromCode) > 0 then 'add the group indicator me.Code = "'[group=" & me.Group.Name & "]" & vbNewLine & me.Code end if end function
'Insert the script in the database public sub Create dim sqlInsert sqlInsert = "insert into t_script (ScriptCategory, ScriptName, ScriptAuthor, Notes, Script) " & _ " Values ('" & scriptCategory & "','" & me.GUID & "','" & me.Group.GUID & "','<Script Name=""" & me.Name & """ Type=""Internal"" Language=""VBScript""/>','" & escapeSQLString(me.Code) & "')" Repository.Execute sqlInsert end sub
'update the script in the database public sub Update dim sqlUpdate sqlUpdate = "update t_script set script = '" & escapeSQLString(me.Code) & "', ScriptAuthor = '" & me.Group.GUID & _ "', Notes = '<Script Name=""" & me.Name & """ Type=""Internal"" Language=""VBScript""/>' where ScriptName = '" & me.GUID & "'" Session.Output sqlUpdate Repository.Execute sqlUpdate end sub
end Class
