'****************************************** ' Ownership '****************************************** ' Ownedship by element and expected metatype' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Function: getOwnedElementNameList ' Purpose: This function returns a list of names of elements owned by the ' provided 'element' that match any type within the 'ownedMetatypeList'. ' The function also includes the 'objectState' property value of the owned elements, if it exists. ' ' Inputs: ' - element: The EA.Element for which the owned elements' names are retrieved. ' - ownedMetatypeList: A string containing a comma-separated list of metatypes to filter owned elements. ' ' Outputs: ' - A string list of names of the owned elements matching the types in 'ownedMetatypeList', ' each name is followed by the element's 'objectState' if it exists. ' Names are separated by a newline character (vbCRLF). ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function getOwnedElementNameList( element, ownedMetatypeList)
dim ownedElement as EA.Element dim nameList 'as String dim typeID 'as Integer dim typeElement as EA.Element dim elementName 'as String dim objectState 'as String
nameList = vbNullString if ownedMetatypeList <> vbNullString then ownedMetatypeList = ownedMetatypeList & "," end if
for each ownedElement in element.EmbeddedElements if InStr( ownedMetatypeList, ownedElement.MetaType & ",") then typeID = ownedElement.PropertyType if typeID = 0 then typeID = ownedElement.ClassfierID end if
if typeID = 0 then elementName = ownedElement.Name else set typeElement = Repository.GetElementByID( typeID) elementName = typeElement.Name end if
if nameList <> vbNullString then nameList = nameList & vbCRLF end if
nameList = nameList & elementName objectState = getCustomPropertyValue( ownedElement, "objectState") if objectState <> vbNullString then nameList = nameList & " [" & objectState & "]" end if end if next getOwnedElementNameList = nameList end function
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Function: getChildElementList ' Purpose: ' returns a list of children of a certain stereotype.This function retrieves a list of child elements of a specified parent ' element that have a specific stereotype. ' ' Inputs: ' - parentElement: The parent EA.Element object for which the child elements ' are to be retrieved. ' - childStereotype: The stereotype of the child elements to retrieve. ' ' Outputs: ' - A Scripting.Dictionary object where the keys are the GUIDs of the child elements and ' the values are the EA.Element objects corresponding to the child elements with ' the provided stereotype. ' -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function getChildElementList( parentElement, childStereotype)
dim childElement as EA.Element dim childElementList 'as Scripting.Dictionary set childElementList = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") for each childElement in parentElement.Elements if childElement.Stereotype = childStereotype then childElementList.Add childElement.ElementGUID, childElement end if next set getChildElementList = childElementList end function
function getCustomPropertyValue( ownedElement, propertyName)
dim customProperty as EA._CustomProperty dim propertyValue 'as String propertyValue = vbNullString
for each customProperty in ownedElement.CustomProperties if customProperty.Name = propertyName then propertyValue = customProperty.Value exit for end if next getCustomPropertyValue = propertyValue
end function
'****************************************** ' Package '****************************************** function getAncestorPackage( element, ancestorPackageLevel)
dim packageLevel 'as Integer dim packageID 'as Integer dim package as EA.Package
packageID = element.PackageID set package = Repository.GetPackageByID( packageID) for packageLevel = 2 to ancestorPackageLevel packageID = package.ParentID if packageID = 0 then exit for end if set package = Repository.GetPackageByID( packageID) next set getAncestorPackage = package
end function '****************************************** ' Diagram '****************************************** ' found a diagram inside an element by name function getChildDiagram( parentElement, childDiagramName)
dim childDiagram as EA.Diagram dim foundDiagram as EA.Diagram
set foundDiagram = nothing
for each childDiagram in parentElement.Diagrams if childDiagram.Name = childDiagramName then set foundDiagram = childDiagram exit for end if next set getChildDiagram = foundDiagram
end function

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Wrappers.Include
' ' Script Name: Export components Tree to Excel ' Author: giu Platania ' Purpose: Exports the list of components to an excel file ' Date: 2023-12-08 ' 'name of the output tab const outPutName = "Export components" dim excelOutput
sub main
'create output tab Repository.CreateOutputTab outPutName Repository.ClearOutput outPutName Repository.EnsureOutputVisible outPutName
'create the excel file set excelOutput = new ExcelFile
'tell the user we are starting Session.Output now() & " Starting components Export " 'do the actual export exportProgrammeTree()
' export the processes Session.Output now() & " Exporting components' processes" exportProcesses() 'export the functions Session.Output now() & " Exporting components' functions" exportFunction() ' export ABEs Session.Output now() & " Exporting components' ABEs" exportABE() ' Export APIs Session.Output now() & " Exporting components' APIs" exportAPI() excelOutput.save excelOutput.close 'tell the user we are finished Session.Output now() & " Finished Export components Tree '"
end sub
function defineHeader() dim messageHeaders(9) messageHeaders(0) = "Function Block" messageHeaders(1) = "Component Name" messageHeaders(2) = "Short Name" messageHeaders(3) = "ID" messageHeaders(4) = "Status" messageHeaders(5) = "Version" messageHeaders(6) = "Release" messageHeaders(7) = "Description" messageHeaders(8) ="Remarks" ' Return the messageHeaders array defineHeader = messageHeaders end function
function defineProcessHeader() dim messageHeaders(6) messageHeaders(0) = "Component Name" messageHeaders(1) = "ID" messageHeaders(2) = "Process Name" messageHeaders(3) = "Process ID" messageHeaders(4) = "Proc. Level" messageHeaders(5) = "Process Documentation"
' Return the messageHeaders array defineProcessHeader = messageHeaders end function
function exportProgrammeTree()
dim getPogrammeTreeContents dim getComponentList dim getComponentList2
getComponentList2 = "SELECT ODAFunctionBlock.Name as 'ODA_FunctionslBlock', TMF_ODAComponents.Name as 'ComponentsName', TMF_ODAComponents.Alias as 'ComponentshortName', " & vbNewLine & _ " CompID.value as 'ID', TMF_ODAComponents.status as 'status', " & vbNewLine & _ " TMF_ODAComponents.version as 'version', TMF_ODAComponents.phase as 'Release', TMF_ODAComponents.Note as 'Description' , CompIssue.notes as 'Remarks' " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS TMF_ODAComponents " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_connector as connector ON TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID = connector.Start_Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS ODAFunctionBlock ON connector.End_Object_ID = ODAFunctionBlock.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS CompID ON (CompID.Object_ID = TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID AND CompID.property = 'ID') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS CompIssue ON (CompIssue.Object_ID = TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID AND CompIssue.property = 'issue') " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE TMF_ODAComponents.Stereotype='TMF_ISC' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND ODAFunctionBlock.Stereotype='TMF_ODAFunctionBlock' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND connector.Stereotype='TMF_BlockContainsFunction' " dim arrayResult arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getComponentList2) dim messageHeaders messageHeaders = defineHeader()
if Ubound(arrayResult) > 0 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders)
excelOutput.createTab "Components", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" 'excelOutput.save
else Session.Output now() & " Empty query!" end if end function
function exportProcesses()
dim getPogrammeTreeContents dim getComponentList dim getComponentList2
getComponentList2 = "SELECT Distinct TMF_ODAComponents.name, TMF_IIC_ID.value as 'ComponentID', ProcID.value as ProcessID, TMF_Process.Name as TMF_Process, HierarchiLevel.value as 'level', TMF_Process.Note as [Docs.Formatted] " & vbNewLine & _ " --, CompID.value, TMF_ODAComponents.Name as TMF_ODAComponents, " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS TMF_ODAComponents " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_connector as connector ON TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID = connector.Start_Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS TMF_Process ON connector.End_Object_ID = TMF_Process.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS ProcID ON (ProcID .Object_ID = TMF_Process.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND ProcID .property = 'Process Identifier') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS HierarchiLevel ON (HierarchiLevel.Object_ID = TMF_Process.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND HierarchiLevel.property = 'HierarchyLevel') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties TMF_IIC_ID on (TMF_IIC_ID.Object_ID = TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID AND TMF_IIC_ID.property = 'ID') " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE TMF_ODAComponents.Stereotype='TMF_IIC' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_Process.Stereotype='TMF_Process' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND connector.Stereotype='TMF_ComponentDependsProcess' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_ODAComponents.status NOT like 'TODO' "
dim arrayResult arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getComponentList2) dim messageHeaders messageHeaders = defineProcessHeader()
if Ubound(arrayResult) > 0 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders) excelOutput.createTab "Processes", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" 'excelOutput.save
else Session.Output now() & " Empty query!" end if end function
function defineAPIHeader() dim messageHeaders(6) messageHeaders(0) = "Component Name" messageHeaders(1) = "ID" messageHeaders(2) = "API ID" messageHeaders(3) = "API Name" messageHeaders(4) = "Type" messageHeaders(5) = "Mandatory"
' Return the messageHeaders array defineAPIHeader = messageHeaders end function
function exportAPI()
dim getPogrammeTreeContents dim getComponentList dim getComponentList2
getComponentList2 = "SELECT TMF_IIC.name as 'component', TMF_IIC_ID.value as 'compID', TMF_API_ID.value as 'APIID', TMF_API.Name as 'API', " & vbNewLine & _ " Replace(Replace(TMF_API_INST.stereotype, 'TMF_ExposedAPI', 'Exposed API'), 'TMF_RequiredAPI', 'Dependent API') as 'type', " & vbNewLine & _ " TMF_API_INST_REQ.value as 'isMandatory' " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS TMF_IIC " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS TMF_API_INST on (TMF_API_INST.ParentID = TMF_IIC.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS TMF_API on (TMF_API_INST.Classifier = TMF_API.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties TMF_IIC_ID on (TMF_IIC_ID.Object_ID = TMF_IIC.Object_ID AND TMF_IIC_ID.property = 'ID') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties TMF_API_ID on (TMF_API_ID.Object_ID = TMF_API.Object_ID AND TMF_API_ID.property = 'ID') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties TMF_API_INST_REQ on (TMF_API_INST_REQ.Object_ID = TMF_API_INST.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE TMF_IIC.Stereotype='TMF_IIC' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND (TMF_API_INST.Stereotype = 'TMF_ExposedAPI' OR TMF_API_INST.Stereotype = 'TMF_RequiredAPI' ) " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_IIC.status NOT like 'TODO' "
dim arrayResult arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getComponentList2) dim messageHeaders messageHeaders = defineAPIHeader()
if Ubound(arrayResult) > 0 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders) excelOutput.createTab "API", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" else Session.Output now() & " Empty query!" end if end function
function defineABEHeader() dim messageHeaders(5) messageHeaders(0) = "Component Name" messageHeaders(1) = "ID" messageHeaders(2) = "ABE Name" messageHeaders(3) = "Level" messageHeaders(4) = "ABE Documentation"
' Return the messageHeaders array defineABEHeader = messageHeaders end function
function exportABE()
dim getPogrammeTreeContents dim getComponentList dim getComponentList2
getComponentList2 = "SELECT distinct TMF_ODAComponents.name, TMF_IIC_ID.value, TMF_ABE.Name as TMF_ABE, HierarchiLevel.value as 'level', TMF_ABE.Note as [Docs.Formatted] " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS TMF_ODAComponents " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_connector as connector ON TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID = connector.Start_Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties TMF_IIC_ID on (TMF_IIC_ID.Object_ID = TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID AND TMF_IIC_ID.property = 'ID') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS TMF_ABE ON connector.End_Object_ID= TMF_ABE.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS HierarchiLevel ON (HierarchiLevel.Object_ID = TMF_ABE.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND HierarchiLevel.property = 'HierarchyLevel') " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE TMF_ODAComponents.Stereotype='TMF_IIC' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_ODAComponents.status NOT like 'TODO' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_ABE.Stereotype='TMF_ABE' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND connector.Stereotype='TMF_ComponentDependsOnABE' "
dim arrayResult arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getComponentList2) dim messageHeaders messageHeaders = defineABEHeader()
if Ubound(arrayResult) > 0 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders) excelOutput.createTab "ABE", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" else Session.Output now() & " Empty query!" end if end function
function defineFunctionHeader() dim messageHeaders(7) messageHeaders(0) = "Component Name" messageHeaders(1) = "ID" messageHeaders(2) = "Function ID" messageHeaders(4) = "AF lev 2" messageHeaders(5) = "AF lev 1" messageHeaders(6) = "Function Documentation"
' Return the messageHeaders array defineFunctionHeader = messageHeaders end function
function exportFunction()
dim getPogrammeTreeContents dim getComponentList dim getComponentList2
getComponentList2 = "SELECT TMF_ODAComponents.name, CompID.value, FunctionIdentifier.value as 'FunctionID', TMF_Function.Name as TMF_Function, aDomain.Name as 'AggregatedFunctionLev2', aDomain1.Name as AggregatedFunctionlev1, " & vbNewLine & _ " TMF_Function.Note as [Docs.Formatted] " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " ---TMF_ODAComponents.Name as TMF_ODAComponents, " & vbNewLine & _ " FROM t_object AS TMF_ODAComponents " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_connector as connector ON TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID = connector.End_Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS TMF_Function ON connector.Start_Object_ID = TMF_Function.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS CompID ON (CompID.Object_ID = TMF_ODAComponents.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND CompID.property = 'ID') " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS FunctionIdentifier ON (FunctionIdentifier.Object_ID = TMF_Function.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND FunctionIdentifier.property = 'Function Identifier') " & vbNewLine & _ " -- AF lev 2 " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_connector as DomainConnector ON (TMF_Function.Object_ID = DomainConnector.Start_Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND (DomainConnector.Stereotype = 'TMF_DomainAggregatesFunction' OR DomainConnector.Stereotype = 'TMF_AFAggregatesFunction')) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS aDomain ON DomainConnector.End_Object_ID= aDomain.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " -- AF lev 1 " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_connector as Domain1Connector1 ON (aDomain.Object_ID = Domain1Connector1.Start_Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " AND (Domain1Connector1.Stereotype = 'TMF_DomainAggregatesDomain' OR Domain1Connector1.Stereotype = 'TMF_AFAggregatesAF')) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_object AS aDomain1 ON Domain1Connector1.End_Object_ID= aDomain1.Object_ID " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " WHERE TMF_ODAComponents.Stereotype='TMF_IIC' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_Function.Stereotype='TMF_Function' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND connector.Connector_Type ='Dependency' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND TMF_ODAComponents.status NOT like 'TODO' "
dim arrayResult arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getComponentList2) dim messageHeaders messageHeaders = defineFunctionHeader()
if Ubound(arrayResult) > 0 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders) excelOutput.createTab "Function", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" else Session.Output now() & " Empty query!" end if end function
main

Function StripHTMLCharacters(str) 'Session.Output now() & " stripping HTML" On Error Resume Next Dim htmlRegex Set htmlRegex = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp") If htmlRegex Is Nothing Then ' The VBScript.RegExp library is missing; return the original string Session.Output now() & " The VBScript.RegExp library is missing; return the original string" StripHTMLCharacters = str Else 'Session.Output now() & " The VBScript.RegExp library is present" htmlRegex.IgnoreCase = True htmlRegex.Global = True ' Define the regular expression pattern to match HTML tags and entities htmlRegex.Pattern = "<[^>]+>|&[^;]+;"
' Replace HTML tags and entities with an empty string StripHTMLCharacters = htmlRegex.Replace(str, "") end if End Function

' ' ' Script Name: conf Docx - Components ' Author: Giu Platania ' Purpose: setup the generator to generate a TMFCXXX IIC component ' Instructions: ' 1. class DocumentSelectedComponent
' Define a method to set the SearchValue tagged value of the specified element Public Sub SetSearchValue(elementGuid) Dim searchValueElement ' main element Set searchValueElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid("{93FA3D76-E022-4737-A34E-981F0145DCFA}") Dim taggedValues Set taggedValues = searchValueElement.TaggedValues Dim taggedValue For Each taggedValue In taggedValues If taggedValue.Name = "SearchValue" Then taggedValue.Value = elementGuid taggedValue.Update() Exit For End If Next searchValueElement.Update() End Sub
Public Sub UpdateAppendixTemplate(element) Dim RTFTemplateName RTFTemplateName = "" Dim taggedValue For Each taggedValue In element.taggedValues If taggedValue.Name = "ID" Then RTFTemplateName = RTFTemplateName+taggedValue.Value+"_Appendix" Exit For End If Next Dim endElement ' Model Document appendix ' TODO need first to look for the existence of the template
Set endElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid("{846C6AEB-0BCD-4f9f-84CE-F3AA881B981C}") For Each taggedValue In endElement.taggedValues If taggedValue.Name = "RTFTemplate" Then taggedValue.Value = RTFTemplateName 'taggedValue.Value = "{0414AC96-337F-4ead-B819-21EF097AEE2F}" taggedValue.Update() Exit For End If Next endElement.Update() End Sub
' Define a method to open the Generate Documentation dialog ' NOT IN USE Public Sub OpenGenerateDocumentation Dim docGenerator As EA.DocumentGenerator Set docGenerator = Repository.CreateDocumentGenerator() docGenerator.NewDocument "" docGenerator.DocumentElement "{AF22BFE9-E653-4d73-9FFF-CBB5F2CA1CEC}", 0 End Sub
public sub UpdateMasterDocument(Element) Dim masterElement Dim taggedValue dim componentID
Set componentID = Element.TaggedValues.GetByName("ID")
' Model Document appendix ' TODO need first to look for the existence of the template
Set masterElement = Repository.GetElementByGuid("{F2A36A2B-DF38-4f49-9699-5279DB9320F1}") ' e.g. TMFC001: Product Catalog Management v1.1.0 masterElement.Name = componentID.value & ": " & Element.Name & " v." & Element.version
Set taggedValue = masterElement.TaggedValues.GetByName("ReportTitle") taggedValue.Value = componentID.value taggedValue.Update()
Set taggedValue = masterElement.TaggedValues.GetByName("ReportName") taggedValue.Value = Element.name taggedValue.Update()
' more efficient approach
Set taggedValue = masterElement.TaggedValues.GetByName("ReportVersion") taggedValue.Value = Element.version taggedValue.Update() masterElement.Update() End Sub
end class
' ' Diagram Script main function ' sub OnDiagramScript()
dim diagramID ' the diagram ID where the generator is located diagramID = "5978" dim currentDiagram as EA.Diagram set currentDiagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram()
if not currentDiagram is nothing then ' Get a reference to any selected objects dim selectedObjects as EA.Collection set selectedObjects = currentDiagram.SelectedObjects Session.Output now() & " # selected " & selectedObjects.Count
' Get a reference to the current element dim currentElement as EA.Element '' this is wrong, you want to select in the diagram '' set currentElement = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() else Session.Prompt "This script requires a diagram to be visible", promptOK end if
If selectedObjects.Count > 0 Then Set currentElement = Repository.GetElementByID(selectedObjects(0).ElementID) End If
'' Giu: this needs to be the stereotype Session.Output now() & " selected: " & currentElement.Stereotype If currentElement.Stereotype <> "TMF_IIC" Then Session.Prompt "ERROR! This script requires an IIC to be selected a" & currentElement.Stereotype , promptOK Set currentElement = Nothing End If
if not currentElement is nothing then dim genDoc set genDoc = new DocumentSelectedComponent genDoc.SetSearchValue(currentElement.ElementGUID) genDoc.UpdateAppendixTemplate(currentElement) genDoc.UpdateMasterDocument(currentElement) Repository.OpenDiagram(diagramID) Session.Prompt currentElement.Name & " configured! Please start the generation with F8", promptOK end if
end sub

'Description', process.value as eTOMmapping, ABE.value as ABE, " & vbNewLine & _ " txtformula.value as 'textFormula', busvalue.Notes as 'BusinessValue' " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " from ((((((((((((t_object Metric " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS ABE ON ABE.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS process ON process.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS units ON units.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS busvalue ON busvalue.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS txtformula ON txtformula.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS category3 ON category3.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS category2 ON category2.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS category1 ON category1.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS maturity ON (maturity.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID AND maturity.property='maturity')) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS mgroup ON mgroup.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS metrictype ON metrictype.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS tid ON tid.Object_ID = Metric.Object_ID) " & vbNewLine & _ " where " & vbNewLine & _ " Metric.Stereotype='TMF_Metric' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND ABE.property='business objects' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND process.property = 'etommapping' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND metrictype.property='metrictype' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND tid.property='tid' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND mgroup.property='group' " & vbNewLine & _ " " & vbNewLine & _ " and category1.property = 'category1' " & vbNewLine & _ " and category2.property = 'category2' " & vbNewLine & _ " and category3.property = 'category3' " & vbNewLine & _ " and txtformula.property = 'txtformula' " & vbNewLine & _ " and busvalue.property = 'busvalue' " & vbNewLine & _ " and units.property = 'units' " & vbNewLine & _ " AND ( maturity.value ='1-Proposed' OR maturity.value='2-Defined') "
dim arrayResult arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getPogrammeTreeContents)
dim messageHeaders messageHeaders = defineHeader() if IsArray(arrayResult) and UBound(arrayResult) > -1 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders)
excelOutput.createTab "METRICS-NotFullyDeveloped", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" 'excelOutput.saveTab
end if
end function
main

'create a nested hierarchy of ABEs starting from a package.
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Create Nested Hierarchy Diagram !INC BIZBOK Diagram Utility Scripts.Color Constants
sub OnProjectBrowserScript()
dim treeSelectedType dim thePackage as EA.Package dim levelList ' as Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim element as EA.Element treeSelectedType = Repository.GetTreeSelectedItemType()
select case treeSelectedType case otPackage set thePackage = Repository.GetTreeSelectedObject() set levelList = getDiagramLevelList ' for each element in thePackage.Elements ' for each subElement in element.Elements ' if element.MetaType = "ABE" then CreateNestedHierarchyDiagram thePackage, levelList, "Capability", false '''params: parentItem, levelList, diagramType, openDiagram ' end if ' next ' next case else Session.Prompt "This script does not support items of this type.", promptOK end select end sub
OnProjectBrowserScript
sub Test(packageGUID)
dim aPackage As EA.Package dim levelList ' as Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) set aPackage = Repository.GetPackageByGuid(packageGUID) set levelList = getDiagramLevelList CreateNestedHierarchyDiagram aPackage, "ABE", levelList
end sub
function getDiagramLevelList
dim levelList ' as Scripting.Dictionary(Of HierarchyLevel) dim level1 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level2 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level3 ' as HierarchyLevel dim level4 ' as HierarchyLevel
set levelList = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
' *** FIRST LEVEL ***
set level1 = New HierarchyLevel
level1.numObjects = 3 level1.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION level1.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level1.elementMetatype = "Capability" level1.objectHeight = 120 level1.objectWidth = 345 level1.horizOffset = 20 level1.horizSpace = 10 level1.vertOffset = 10 level1.vertSpace = 10
'level1.objectStyle.fillColor = colorDeepSkyBlue 'level1.objectStyle.lineWidth = 2 level1.objectStyle.lineColor = colorSilver level1.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level1.objectStyle.fontSize = 18 level1.objectStyle.fontColor = colorGray40
levelList.Add 1, level1
' *** SECOND LEVEL ***
set level2 = New HierarchyLevel
level2.numObjects = 3 level2.flowDirection = LEFT_RIGHT_FLOW_DIRECTION
level2.elementMetatype = "Capability" level2.objectHeight = 60 level2.objectWidth = 150 level2.horizOffset = 20 level2.horizSpace = 5 level2.vertOffset = 60 level2.vertSpace = 5
'level2.objectStyle.fillColor = colorDeepSkyBlue 'level2.objectStyle.lineWidth = 1 level2.objectStyle.lineColor = colorSilver level2.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level2.objectStyle.fontSize = 10 level2.objectStyle.fontColor = colorGray40
levelList.Add 2, level2
' *** THIRD LEVEL ***
set level3 = New HierarchyLevel
level3.numObjects = 3 level3.flowDirection = TOP_DOWN_FLOW_DIRECTION
level3.elementMetatype = "Capability" level3.objectHeight = 60 level3.objectWidth = 120 level3.horizOffset = 20 level3.horizSpace = 3 level3.vertOffset = 50 level3.vertSpace = 3
'level3.objectStyle.fillColor = colorLightCoral 'level3.objectStyle.lineWidth = 1 level3.objectStyle.lineColor = colorSilver level3.objectStyle.fontName = "Arial" level3.objectStyle.fontSize = 8 level3.objectStyle.fontColor = colorGray40

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Wrappers.Include
' Script Name: Export Capabilities to Excel ' Purpose: Exports the list of capabilities to an Excel file ' Date: 2024-12-06
'name of the output tab const outPutName = "Export Capabilities" dim excelOutput
sub main 'create output tab Repository.CreateOutputTab outPutName Repository.ClearOutput outPutName Repository.EnsureOutputVisible outPutName
'create the Excel file set excelOutput = new ExcelFile
'tell the user we are starting Session.Output now() & " Starting Capabilities Export"
'do the actual export exportCapabilities()
'save and close the Excel file excelOutput.save excelOutput.close
'tell the user we are finished Session.Output now() & " Finished Export Capabilities" end sub
function defineHeader() dim messageHeaders(16) messageHeaders(0) = "Object_ID" messageHeaders(1) = "CLASSGUID" messageHeaders(2) = "CLASSTYPE" messageHeaders(3) = "Capability" messageHeaders(4) = "BusinessValue" messageHeaders(5) = "Category" messageHeaders(6) = "ID" messageHeaders(7) = "Owner" messageHeaders(8) = "Source" messageHeaders(9) = "Increments" messageHeaders(10) = "IncrementsToBe" messageHeaders(11) = "IncrementVertical" messageHeaders(12) = "IncrementSupplyChain" messageHeaders(13) = "Cost" messageHeaders(14) = "Criticality" messageHeaders(15) = "Risk"
' Return the messageHeaders array defineHeader = messageHeaders end function
function exportCapabilities() dim getCapabilitiesQuery dim arrayResult dim messageHeaders
' Define the SQL query getCapabilitiesQuery = "SELECT Distinct Capability.Object_ID, Capability.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, Capability.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE," & vbNewLine & _ " Capability.Name AS Capability, BusinessValue.value AS BusinessValue, Category.value AS Category," & vbNewLine & _ " ID.value AS ID, Owner.value AS Owner, Source.value AS Source, Increments.value AS Increments," & vbNewLine & _ " IncrementsToBe.value AS IncrementsToBe, IncrementVertical.value AS IncrementVertical," & vbNewLine & _ " IncrementSupplyChain.value AS IncrementSupplyChain, Cost.value AS Cost," & vbNewLine & _ " Criticality.value AS Criticality, Risk.value AS Risk" & vbNewLine & _ "FROM t_object AS Capability" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS BusinessValue ON (BusinessValue.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND BusinessValue.Property = 'BusinessValue')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Category ON (Category.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Category.Property = 'Category')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS ID ON (ID.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND ID.Property = 'ID')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Owner ON (Owner.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Owner.Property = 'Owner')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Source ON (Source.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Source.Property = 'Source')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Increments ON (Increments.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Increments.Property = 'Increments')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS IncrementsToBe ON (IncrementsToBe.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND IncrementsToBe.Property = 'IncrementsToBe')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS IncrementVertical ON (IncrementVertical.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND IncrementVertical.Property = 'IncrementVertical')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS IncrementSupplyChain ON (IncrementSupplyChain.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND IncrementSupplyChain.Property = 'IncrementSupplyChain')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Cost ON (Cost.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Cost.Property = 'Cost')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Criticality ON (Criticality.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Criticality.Property = 'Criticality')" & vbNewLine & _ "INNER JOIN t_objectproperties AS Risk ON (Risk.Object_ID = Capability.Object_ID AND Risk.Property = 'Risk')" & vbNewLine & _ "WHERE Capability.stereotype = 'dCapability'"
' Execute the query and get the result as an array arrayResult = getArrayFromQuery(getCapabilitiesQuery) messageHeaders = defineHeader()
if Ubound(arrayResult) > 0 then dim mergedArray mergedArray = AddRowToArray(arrayResult, messageHeaders)
' Create a tab in Excel with the results excelOutput.createTab "Capabilities", mergedArray, true, "TableStyleMedium13" else Session.Output now() & " Empty query!" end if end function
main

option explicit
!INC Local Scripts.EAConstants-VBScript !INC Utils.Model Management Utilities !INC Utils.DAF Conf
' ' Script Name: PromoteStereotypesToCatalogs ' Author: Giu Platania ' Date: 2025-01-22 ' Purpose: ' This script reads a CSV file containing stereotype and package GUID mappings ' and promotes elements with specified stereotypes to their respective catalogs/packages. ' It automates the task of reorganizing elements into their designated repositories.
' Description: ' This script performs the following steps: ' - Reads a two-dimensional array of stereotypes and their corresponding package GUIDs from a CSV file. ' - Iterates through a given diagram's elements to check for specified stereotypes. ' - Moves the elements to the package specified in the CSV mapping. ' - Skips elements with unrecognized stereotypes and outputs relevant debug information. ' ' Usage: ' 1. Configure/generate the CSV file with stereotype and package GUID mappings. ' 2. Update the script DAF Conf to the location of the CSV file ' 3. import thew packages of the Architecture Landscape ' 4. Run the script within Sparx EA to promote stereotypes to their catalogs. ' ' Inputs: ' - Diagram with elements to be checked and promoted. ' - CSV file containing stereotype-to-package GUID mappings. ' ' Outputs: ' - Elements moved to the appropriate catalogs/packages. ' - Debug output in the Sparx EA script console for skipped or processed elements. ' ' Notes: ' - Ensure that the CSV file is correctly formatted with stereotype names in the first column and package GUIDs in the second column. ' - The script assumes the existence of the target packages within the EA repository. ' - Skips elements with unrecognized stereotypes or missing tagged values. '
' !INC DAF MDG.Model Management Utilities !INC DAF MDG.DAF M3 Conf !INC Wrappers.Include
Dim project as EA.Project
' ' Diagram Script main function
sub Start()
dim diagram as EA.Diagram set project = Repository.GetProjectInterface() set diagram = Repository.GetCurrentDiagram if not diagram is nothing then Session.Output "diagram found!" RelocateDiagramElements diagram end if end sub
Sub RelocateDiagramElements(diagram)
Dim stereotypePackageMap Dim diagramObject As EA.DiagramObject Dim elementID Dim element As EA.Element Dim targetPackage As EA.Package
' Load the stereotype-to-package map from the CSV file Set stereotypePackageMap = LoadStereotypePackageMap(CSVPath & "DAFCatalogs.csv")
' Iterate through all diagram elements For Each diagramObject In diagram.DiagramObjects elementID = diagramObject.ElementID Set element = Repository.GetElementByID(elementID) Session.Output "Processing element: " & element.Name
' Check if the stereotype exists in the map If stereotypePackageMap.Exists(element.Stereotype) Then Set targetPackage = Repository.GetPackageByGuid(stereotypePackageMap(element.Stereotype))
' Move the element to the target package element.PackageID = targetPackage.PackageID element.Update Session.Output "Moved element: " & element.Name & " to package: " & targetPackage.Name Else ' Skip elements with unknown stereotypes Session.Output "Skipping element: " & element.Name & " with unknown stereotype: " & element.Stereotype End If Next
End Sub
' Function to load the stereotype-to-package mapping from a CSV file Function LoadStereotypePackageMap(csvFilePath) Dim fso, file, line, columns Dim map Set map = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
' Open the CSV file Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") If Not fso.FileExists(csvFilePath) Then Session.Output "CSV file not found: " & csvFilePath Exit Function End If
Set file = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1) file.SkipLine ' Skip the header row
' Read each line and populate the dictionary Do Until file.AtEndOfStream line = file.ReadLine columns = Split(line, ",") If UBound(columns) >= 1 Then map(columns(0)) = columns(1) ' Map stereotype to package GUID End If Loop
file.Close Set LoadStereotypePackageMap = map End Function
Start
